postwar_en: The sentence was reduced to twelve years, and Manstein was released for health reasons in 1953. He later advised the West German defence establishment and contributed to the postwar image of a supposedly apolitical Wehrmacht.
limitations_en: Estimates for crimes across the Eleventh Army's area combine the actions of military, SS, police and auxiliary formations and cannot be treated as Manstein's personal victim total. Sources also differ by a day on the date recorded for his death in June 1973.

name: Oswald Rothaug
tier_label_fr: Rouages de la guerre et de l’occupation
organization_en: Nuremberg Special Court, Reich prosecution service and the People's Court
role_en: presiding judge of the Nuremberg Special Court and later Reich prosecutor at the People's Court
role_pl: Prezes Sondergericht Nürnberg; „krwawy sędzia”
role_de: Vorsitzender Richter am Sondergericht Nürnberg und später Reichsanwalt beim Volksgerichtshof
role_ru: председательствующий судья Нюрнбергского особого суда, позднее — имперский прокурор при Народной судебной палате
role_fr: président du tribunal spécial de Nuremberg puis procureur du Reich auprès du Tribunal du peuple
status_en: sentenced to life imprisonment in the Judges' Trial; released in 1956
interpretation_en: Rothaug exercised judicial power as a mechanism of persecution: he converted law and procedure into tools for racial and political terror. The profile is confined to judgments and conduct supported by the trial record, not every decision of the special-court system.
postwar_en: Rothaug's life sentence was later reduced to twenty years. He was released from Landsberg prison in 1956 and died in 1967 without further punishment.
limitations_en: No single reliable total exists for death sentences attributable to Rothaug personally. His contacts with the SD are documented, but the source base does not establish formal SS membership.

name: Otto Ambros
tier_label_fr: Rouages de la guerre et de l’occupation
organization_en: IG Farben and the Buna/Monowitz industrial complex
role_en: IG Farben board member responsible for Buna/Monowitz and chemical-warfare agent production programmes
role_pl: Dyrektor IG Farben, kluczowy menedżer Buna/Monowitz i produkcji gazów bojowych
role_de: Vorstandsmitglied der IG Farben, zuständig für Buna/Monowitz und Programme zur Herstellung chemischer Kampfstoffe
role_ru: член правления IG Farben, отвечавший за Buna/Моновиц и программы производства химических боевых отравляющих веществ
role_fr: membre du directoire d’IG Farben responsable de Buna/Monowitz et des programmes de production d’agents de guerre chimique
status_en: convicted in the IG Farben Trial and sentenced to eight years; released in 1951
interpretation_en: Ambros joined corporate authority to the SS-controlled supply and replacement of exhausted prisoners at Monowitz. His responsibility concerns the industrial system he helped choose and direct, while camp selections and killings also involved SS offices and other managers.
postwar_en: Ambros served only part of his sentence and was released from Landsberg in 1951. He subsequently returned to work as an adviser and executive in the West German chemical industry and died in 1990.
limitations_en: Estimates for people exploited or killed differ according to whether they cover Ambros's directly supervised plants, Monowitz as a whole or the broader Auschwitz labour complex. Ambros joined the NSDAP but was not an SS member.

name: Bruno Tesch
tier_label_fr: Rouages de la guerre et de l’occupation
organization_en: Tesch & Stabenow (Testa), chemical-distribution company
role_en: co-owner and managing director of a principal distributor of Zyklon B
role_pl: Współwłaściciel firmy Tesch & Stabenow (Testa) — dostawcy Cyklonu B
role_de: Mitinhaber und Geschäftsführer eines Hauptvertreibers von Zyklon B
role_ru: совладелец и управляющий директор одного из главных дистрибьюторов «Циклона Б»
role_fr: copropriétaire et directeur général d’un des principaux distributeurs de Zyklon B
region_en: Hamburg and concentration camps supplied by Testa, including Auschwitz
status_en: convicted by a British military court in the Zyklon B case and executed in 1946
interpretation_en: Tesch's responsibility was that of a commercial supplier whose knowledge and decisions were examined at trial. The profile does not equate every shipment with homicidal use or assign the full number murdered with Zyklon B to one distributor.
postwar_en: British authorities tried Tesch in Hamburg in March 1946. He and company officer Karl Weinbacher were sentenced to death; Tesch was executed in May 1946.
limitations_en: Zyklon B also had legitimate disinfestation uses, so responsibility depends on the court's finding of knowledge, not the product alone. Camp-wide estimates for people murdered with the gas are not an individual victim count for Tesch. He must not be confused with the younger anti-Nazi worker of the same name.

name: Franz Böhme
tier_label_fr: Rouages de la guerre et de l’occupation
organization_en: Wehrmacht occupation command in Serbia
role_en: Plenipotentiary Commanding General in occupied Serbia in autumn 1941
role_pl: Pełnomocny Dowódca Generalny w Serbii, odpowiedzialny za masowe rozstrzeliwania odwetowe 100:1
role_de: Bevollmächtigter Kommandierender General im besetzten Serbien im Herbst 1941
role_ru: полномочный командующий генерал в оккупированной Сербии осенью 1941 года
role_fr: général plénipotentiaire commandant en Serbie occupée à l’automne 1941
region_en: occupied Serbia and Yugoslavia; later Norway
status_en: indicted in the Hostages Trial but died by suicide in 1947 before trial
interpretation_en: Böhme transformed superior reprisal policy into binding operational orders and oversaw its application. Responsibility is based on command and orders, while particular massacres were executed by named subordinate units and involved their own chains of responsibility.
postwar_en: Captured in Norway, Böhme was transferred to Nuremberg and indicted in the Hostages Trial of senior southeastern commanders. He died before the tribunal could hear and decide his case.
limitations_en: Totals for the autumn 1941 reprisals vary by place and source and overlap with the responsibility of subordinate commanders and units. Böhme was a career Wehrmacht officer; the canonical record does not establish NSDAP or SS membership.

name: Walther Dürrfeld
tier_label_fr: Rouages de la guerre et de l’occupation
organization_en: IG Farben, Auschwitz/Monowitz Buna works
role_en: technical director and construction manager of the IG Farben works at Auschwitz-Monowitz
role_pl: Dyrektor techniczny i kierownik budowy IG Auschwitz/Monowitz
role_de: technischer Direktor und Bauleiter der IG-Farben-Werke in Auschwitz-Monowitz
role_ru: технический директор и руководитель строительства завода IG Farben в Аушвице-Моновице
role_fr: directeur technique et responsable des travaux de l’usine IG Farben d’Auschwitz-Monowitz
status_en: convicted in the IG Farben Trial and sentenced to eight years; released early in 1951
interpretation_en: Dürrfeld occupied the operational point where corporate construction demands met the SS camp labour system. This establishes managerial responsibility for exploitation at the site, without making him the sole author of all deaths in Monowitz or the Auschwitz complex.
postwar_en: Dürrfeld received one of the longest sentences imposed in the IG Farben Trial but was released from Landsberg in 1951. He later worked again in West German industry and died in 1967.
limitations_en: The documented death toll for Monowitz is narrower than figures for the entire Auschwitz forced-labour system. These institutional totals involve IG Farben executives, plant managers and SS authorities and are not a personal total for Dürrfeld.

name: Irma Grese
organization_en: SS camp system and SS-Gefolge
role_en: female guard and senior supervisor at Ravensbrück, Auschwitz-Birkenau and Bergen-Belsen
role_pl: Aufseherin / Oberaufseherin w Ravensbrück i Birkenau; później w Bergen-Belsen
role_de: Aufseherin und leitende Oberaufseherin in Ravensbrück, Auschwitz-Birkenau und Bergen-Belsen
role_ru: надзирательница и старшая надзирательница в Равенсбрюке, Аушвице-Биркенау и Берген-Бельзене
role_fr: gardienne et surveillante principale à Ravensbrück, Auschwitz-Birkenau et Bergen-Belsen
status_en: convicted in the Belsen Trial and executed in December 1945
interpretation_en: Grese's responsibility was direct and local: she exercised coercive authority over prisoners and took part in documented violence and selections. The profile does not assign to her the total number of people murdered at every camp in which she served.
postwar_en: British forces arrested Grese after the liberation of Bergen-Belsen. The Lüneburg tribunal sentenced her to death in November 1945, and the sentence was carried out the following month.
limitations_en: Witness evidence establishes specific forms of abuse and participation in selections, but no reliable individual victim total can be calculated for one guard. Female guards belonged to the SS auxiliary staff and did not hold regular SS military ranks.

name: Hermine Braunsteiner
organization_en: SS camp system and SS-Gefolge
role_en: female guard at Ravensbrück and Majdanek known for direct brutality toward prisoners
role_pl: Aufseherin w Ravensbrück i Majdanku; wyjątkowo brutalna strażniczka
role_de: Aufseherin in Ravensbrück und Majdanek, bekannt für unmittelbare Brutalität gegen Häftlinge
role_ru: надзирательница в Равенсбрюке и Майданеке, известная прямой жестокостью по отношению к заключённым
role_fr: gardienne à Ravensbrück et Majdanek, connue pour sa brutalité directe envers les détenus
status_en: extradited from the United States and sentenced to life imprisonment in the Düsseldorf Majdanek Trial
interpretation_en: Her responsibility is documented at the level of a guard who personally enforced camp terror and participated in lethal selections. The profile distinguishes those acts from the overall crimes of Majdanek and its command structure.
postwar_en: An Austrian court first sentenced Braunsteiner to three years in 1949 for abuse at Ravensbrück. After living in the United States under her married name, she was identified, stripped of citizenship, extradited and later convicted in West Germany; she was released for health reasons in 1996.
limitations_en: The Düsseldorf judgment supports specified murders and participation in collective killings, but the total suffering caused by her cannot be reduced to a precise personal count. Sources differ over how to classify her place among operational camp perpetrators and local guards.

name: Wilhelm Trapp
organization_en: Order Police, Reserve Police Battalion 101
role_en: commander of Reserve Police Battalion 101 during shootings and deportations in the Lublin district
role_pl: Dowódca 101. Rezerwowego Batalionu Policji, odpowiedzialny za masowe rozstrzeliwania w Józefowie i Łomazach
role_de: Kommandeur des Reserve-Polizei-Bataillons 101 bei Erschießungen und Deportationen im Distrikt Lublin
role_ru: командир резервного полицейского батальона 101 во время расстрелов и депортаций в Люблинском округе
role_fr: commandant du 101e bataillon de réserve de police lors de fusillades et de déportations dans le district de Lublin
region_en: the Lublin district of occupied Poland
status_en: convicted by a Polish court and executed in Siedlce in 1948
interpretation_en: Trapp's case shows how an Order Police commander translated deportation and killing orders into assignments for ordinary reserve policemen. His command responsibility does not remove the agency of company officers and individual shooters or make every later battalion crime his personal act.
postwar_en: Poland tried Trapp before the District Court in Siedlce and sentenced him to death on 6 July 1948. The sentence was carried out in December together with that of another battalion officer.
limitations_en: The often cited overall record of Battalion 101 includes actions carried out with other SS and police formations, including Operation Harvest Festival. It is not a number of people killed personally or solely on Trapp's individual order.

name: Dorothea Binz
organization_en: SS camp system and SS-Gefolge
role_en: deputy senior female supervisor at Ravensbrück and trainer of camp guards
role_pl: Stellvertretende Oberaufseherin w Ravensbrück; szkoląca inne nadzorczynie
role_de: stellvertretende Oberaufseherin in Ravensbrück und Ausbilderin von Lageraufseherinnen
role_ru: заместительница старшей надзирательницы в Равенсбрюке и инструктор лагерных охранниц
role_fr: adjointe à la surveillante principale à Ravensbrück et formatrice de gardiennes de camp
status_en: convicted in the first Ravensbrück Trial and executed in 1947
interpretation_en: Binz combined direct violence with supervisory and training authority that reproduced camp practices beyond her own actions. The profile does not use the total deaths at Ravensbrück as a personal count.
postwar_en: Binz was captured by British forces in May 1945. A British military tribunal in Hamburg convicted and sentenced her to death in the first Ravensbrück staff trial.
limitations_en: Sources differ on the precise date of her promotion and some biographical details. As a female auxiliary guard she did not hold a regular SS military rank; the number of victims directly attributable to her cannot be stated precisely.

name: Herta Oberheuser
organization_en: Ravensbrück camp medical service and SS auxiliary staff
role_en: physician who participated in criminal medical experiments on prisoners at Ravensbrück
role_pl: Lekarka w obozie koncentracyjnym Ravensbrück, przeprowadzająca zbrodnicze eksperymenty na Polkach
role_de: Ärztin, die an verbrecherischen medizinischen Experimenten an Häftlingen in Ravensbrück beteiligt war
role_ru: врач, участвовавшая в преступных медицинских экспериментах над заключёнными в Равенсбрюке
role_fr: médecin ayant participé à des expériences médicales criminelles sur des détenues à Ravensbrück
status_en: convicted in the Doctors' Trial and sentenced to twenty years; released in 1952
interpretation_en: Oberheuser's medical role made her an active participant in experimentation rather than a neutral clinician. Responsibility is based on documented selections, procedures and withholding of care, not on every experiment conducted at Ravensbrück.
postwar_en: Oberheuser was the only woman among the defendants in the Doctors' Trial. Her sentence was reduced and she left Landsberg in 1952; she resumed medical work until survivors recognised her and authorities withdrew her right to practise.
limitations_en: Sources differ on the number of deaths directly caused by the experimental programme and on the precise date her medical licence was finally withdrawn. She served as auxiliary personnel and did not hold an independent SS rank.

name: Otto Dietrich
organization_en: NSDAP press leadership, Reich government and Propaganda Ministry
role_en: Reich press chief and state secretary who issued daily directives controlling the German press
role_pl: Szef prasy Rzeszy (Reichspressechef); sekretarz stanu w Ministerstwie Propagandy; wydawał codzienne dyrektywy prasowe
role_de: Reichspressechef und Staatssekretär, der mit täglichen Weisungen die deutsche Presse kontrollierte
role_ru: имперский руководитель печати и статс-секретарь, издававший ежедневные директивы, контролировавшие германскую прессу
role_fr: chef de la presse du Reich et secrétaire d’État qui diffusait les directives quotidiennes contrôlant la presse allemande
status_en: convicted in the Ministries Trial and sentenced to seven years; released in 1950
interpretation_en: Dietrich's agency lay in institutional control over news and the deliberate use of antisemitic propaganda during persecution and genocide. The profile explains contribution and incitement without converting propaganda reach into a numerical personal victim total.
postwar_en: Dietrich received credit for pretrial detention and was released from Landsberg in 1950. He published a memoir about Hitler and died in 1952.
limitations_en: Accounts differ on his place of birth. The historical effect of propaganda can be demonstrated through directives and context, but it cannot be translated into a defensible number of victims attributable to Dietrich alone.

name: Werner Best
organization_en: Gestapo, Security Police, SD and RSHA
role_en: senior Security Police and SD lawyer involved in organising Einsatzgruppen for the 1939 campaign
role_pl: prawnik i funkcjonariusz kierownictwa Sipo/SD współorganizujący Einsatzgruppen na kampanię 1939 roku
role_de: hoher Jurist von Sicherheitspolizei und SD, der an der Organisation der Einsatzgruppen für den Feldzug 1939 beteiligt war
role_ru: старший юрист полиции безопасности и СД, участвовавший в организации айнзацгрупп для кампании 1939 года
role_fr: haut responsable et juriste de la police de sûreté et du SD, impliqué dans l’organisation des Einsatzgruppen pour la campagne de 1939
status_en: convicted in Denmark; after release, West German proceedings did not produce a conviction for his role in the security apparatus
interpretation_en: Best represents the organisational link between central security-police planning and the mobile units deployed during the invasion of Poland. This supports responsibility for creating and coordinating an apparatus, but not automatic attribution of every later field-unit crime.
postwar_en: Best was convicted and imprisoned in Denmark, then released. Investigations in West Germany into his earlier work in the Nazi security apparatus did not result in a final conviction before his death in 1989.
limitations_en: The existing profile establishes Best's institutional role more securely than authorship of individual orders. Claims about particular executions require signed documents or unit reports and must remain separate from his later administration in Denmark.

name: Lothar Beutel
organization_en: Einsatzgruppe IV, Security Police, SD and SS
role_en: commander of Einsatzgruppe IV during the German invasion of Poland
role_pl: dowódca Einsatzgruppe IV podczas napaści na Polskę
role_de: Befehlshaber der Einsatzgruppe IV während des deutschen Überfalls auf Polen
role_ru: командир айнзацгруппы IV во время германского вторжения в Польшу
role_fr: commandant de l’Einsatzgruppe IV pendant l’invasion allemande de la Pologne
status_en: interned and questioned after the war but never finally convicted for Einsatzgruppe IV's operations in Poland
interpretation_en: Beutel's profile documents command of a mobile security-police formation between central planning and local commands. It assigns only actions supported for Einsatzgruppe IV and his tenure, not every crime in the formation's geographic corridor.
postwar_en: Beutel was interned and interrogated after the war. He was not finally convicted for the actions of Einsatzgruppe IV in occupied Poland and died in 1986.
limitations_en: The source base requires event-by-event attribution from Einsatzgruppe IV reports. Geographic presence or command title alone does not justify attributing every local killing to Beutel.

name: Ernst Damzog
organization_en: Einsatzgruppe V, Security Police, SD and Gestapo
role_en: commander of Einsatzgruppe V and later inspector of the Security Police and SD in Poznań
role_pl: dowódca Einsatzgruppe V i późniejszy inspektor Sipo/SD w Poznaniu
role_de: Befehlshaber der Einsatzgruppe V und später Inspekteur der Sicherheitspolizei und des SD in Posen
role_ru: командир айнзацгруппы V и позднее инспектор полиции безопасности и СД в Познани
role_fr: commandant de l’Einsatzgruppe V puis inspecteur de la police de sûreté et du SD à Poznań
region_en: Greater Poland, central Poland and the Wartheland
status_en: died in 1945 and was never tried for his work in occupied Poland
interpretation_en: Damzog's two offices show institutional continuity from a mobile Einsatzgruppe to the consolidated security-police system in annexed territory. Responsibility for each phase must be evaluated separately and cannot encompass every crime committed in the Wartheland.
postwar_en: Damzog did not appear before a court for his role in the invasion-period Einsatzgruppe or the later Poznań police apparatus.
limitations_en: The evidence must distinguish decisions made as Einsatzgruppe V commander from later official responsibility as inspector in Poznań. Formation-wide and regional crimes should not be collapsed into one personal attribution.

name: Udo von Woyrsch
organization_en: SS, Order Police and Einsatzgruppe zur besonderen Verwendung
role_en: commander of a special SS and police operational group in Upper Silesia in 1939
role_pl: dowódca specjalnej grupy operacyjnej SS i policji na Górnym Śląsku w 1939 roku
role_de: Befehlshaber einer besonderen SS- und Polizei-Einsatzgruppe in Oberschlesien 1939
role_ru: командир специальной оперативной группы СС и полиции в Верхней Силезии в 1939 году
role_fr: commandant d’un groupe opérationnel spécial de la SS et de la police en Haute-Silésie en 1939
status_en: convicted in West Germany for prewar Nazi offences, but not fully tried for the 1939 crimes in Poland
interpretation_en: Woyrsch held command and decision-making authority over a distinct special formation. That establishes responsibility for the group's documented course, but particular executions require the unit reports and cannot be inferred solely from his regional remit.
postwar_en: West German courts convicted Woyrsch for Nazi-era offences predating the invasion. His responsibility for the special group's crimes in occupied Poland did not receive a separate, comprehensive final judgment.
limitations_en: The distinction between proven command and attribution of individual shootings is essential. Specific local crimes should be linked to Woyrsch only where operational reports or equivalent records establish the connection.

name: Richard Hildebrandt
organization_en: SS, Higher SS and Police Leader apparatus and RuSHA
role_en: Higher SS and Police Leader in Reich District Danzig–West Prussia
role_pl: wyższy dowódca SS i policji w Okręgu Rzeszy Gdańsk–Prusy Zachodnie
role_de: Höherer SS- und Polizeiführer im Reichsgau Danzig–Westpreußen
role_ru: высший руководитель СС и полиции в имперском округе Данциг — Западная Пруссия
role_fr: chef supérieur de la SS et de la police dans le Reichsgau Dantzig-Prusse-Occidentale
status_en: convicted in the RuSHA Trial, extradited to Poland, sentenced to death and executed in 1952
interpretation_en: Hildebrandt occupied the regional command level coordinating SS and police institutions rather than a single execution detachment. His responsibility must be traced through that authority without assigning every act of EK 16, Selbstschutz or other local formations automatically to him.
postwar_en: Following conviction in the RuSHA case, Hildebrandt was transferred to Polish jurisdiction. A Polish court imposed the death sentence, which was carried out in 1952.
limitations_en: His profile concerns Richard Hildebrandt and must not be confused with similarly named members of the Alvensleben family. Regional command is not by itself proof of personal direction of every local killing.

name: Kurt Eimann
tier_label_fr: Rouages de la guerre et de l’occupation
organization_en: SS-Wachsturmbann Eimann
role_en: commander of SS-Wachsturmbann Eimann during executions in Pomerania
role_pl: dowódca SS-Wachsturmbann „Eimann”
role_de: Befehlshaber des SS-Wachsturmbanns Eimann bei Erschießungen in Pommern
role_ru: командир SS-Wachsturmbann Eimann во время казней в Поморье
role_fr: commandant du SS-Wachsturmbann Eimann lors des exécutions en Poméranie
crime_tags_pl: Masowe egzekucje;eksterminacja elit;Mordowanie osob z niepelnosprawnosciami
status_en: sentenced in West Germany to four years' imprisonment and served approximately two years
interpretation_en: Eimann represents field command and direct implementation by a specialised local SS formation. His profile is limited to operations documented for the battalion and does not absorb the separate responsibility of regional commanders, Gestapo selectors or Selbstschutz units.
postwar_en: Eimann's West German conviction resulted in a four-year sentence, of which he served roughly two years. The judgment did not encompass the full complex of killings at Piaśnica.
limitations_en: Some sources use the first name Karl, so the heading form should be checked against personnel records. The surviving conviction addressed a limited subset of acts and cannot be treated as a complete judicial account of the unit's crimes.

name: Rudolf Tröger
organization_en: Einsatzkommando 16, Gestapo, Security Police and SD
role_en: commander of Einsatzkommando 16 and head of the Gestapo in Danzig
role_pl: dowódca Einsatzkommando 16 i szef gdańskiego Gestapo
role_de: Befehlshaber des Einsatzkommandos 16 und Leiter der Gestapo in Danzig
role_ru: командир айнзацкоманды 16 и начальник гестапо в Данциге
role_fr: commandant de l’Einsatzkommando 16 et chef de la Gestapo à Dantzig
status_en: killed while serving with the Wehrmacht in France in 1940; never tried
interpretation_en: Tröger was the central commander of EK 16, an institutional role distinct from the work of its Gdynia, Bydgoszcz and Toruń branches. The profile therefore identifies command responsibility while preserving the evidence required for branch-level decisions.
postwar_en: Because Tröger died during the war, no court examined his responsibility for EK 16 and the Danzig Gestapo.
limitations_en: Command of EK 16 must be distinguished from decisions taken by individual branch offices and local execution units. Only documented links should be used for specific killings.

name: Friedrich Class
tier_label_fr: Rouages de la guerre et de l’occupation
organization_en: Einsatzkommando 16, Gestapo and Security Police
role_en: head of the Gdynia branch of Einsatzkommando 16 and the Gestapo
role_pl: kierownik gdyńskiej ekspozytury Einsatzkommando 16 i Gestapo
role_de: Leiter der Gdynia-Außenstelle des Einsatzkommandos 16 und der Gestapo
role_ru: начальник гдынского отделения айнзацкоманды 16 и гестапо
role_fr: chef de l’antenne de Gdynia de l’Einsatzkommando 16 et de la Gestapo
status_en: died in December 1945 without trial
interpretation_en: Class illustrates how a field office converted lists and police assessments into selections for extrajudicial killing. His responsibility concerns those documented organisational acts, not every execution in the wider Pomeranian campaign.
postwar_en: No court reached a judgment on Class's role because he died shortly after the war.
limitations_en: The source wording should describe concrete work on lists and selections rather than call these acts judicial approval of sentences: the killings were extrajudicial. The evidentiary boundary of the Gdynia branch must remain explicit.

name: Josef Meisinger
organization_en: Security Police · SD · Gestapo · Einsatzgruppe IV
role_en: commander of the Security Police and SD in the Warsaw district
role_pl: komendant Sipo i SD w dystrykcie warszawskim
role_de: Kommandeur der Sicherheitspolizei und des SD im Distrikt Warschau
role_ru: командир полиции безопасности и СД в Варшавском дистрикте
role_fr: commandant de la police de sûreté et du SD dans le district de Varsovie
region_en: Warsaw, the Warsaw district and Palmiry
status_en: executed in 1947
interpretation_en: The profile places Meisinger between the district administration and the Security Police apparatus that implemented the AB Action. It does not assign to him personally every execution or every crime committed by the police in the Warsaw district.
postwar_en: Meisinger was extradited to Poland, sentenced to death in the Warsaw trial and executed in 1947.
limitations_en: The acts covered by the judgment must be distinguished precisely from the wider official responsibility described in the sources.

name: Ludwig Hahn
organization_en: Security Police · SD · Gestapo · Einsatzkommando 1/I
role_en: commander of the Security Police and SD in the Kraków district and later in the Warsaw district
role_pl: komendant Sipo i SD w dystrykcie krakowskim, a następnie warszawskim
role_de: Kommandeur der Sicherheitspolizei und des SD zunächst im Distrikt Krakau, anschließend im Distrikt Warschau
role_ru: командир полиции безопасности и СД сначала в Краковском, затем в Варшавском дистрикте
role_fr: commandant de la police de sûreté et du SD dans le district de Cracovie puis dans celui de Varsovie
region_en: Kraków, Warsaw and the Warsaw district
status_en: convicted in West Germany but not fully held to account
interpretation_en: The profile connects successive stages of Hahn’s career: the 1939 campaign, the AB Action, the Warsaw Security Police apparatus and the final phase of the occupation. His command role over that police apparatus is not treated as proof that he directed every crime committed by front-line formations during the Warsaw Uprising.
postwar_en: After living openly under his own name for a long period, Hahn was convicted in separate proceedings in West Germany. Those judgments did not cover the full range of his activity in Poland.
limitations_en: The Warsaw Uprising strand concerns the subordinate police apparatus and Pawiak; it must not be converted into automatic attribution of crimes committed by front-line units.

name: Max Daume
tier_label_fr: Rouages de la guerre et de l’occupation
organization_en: Order Police · Schutzpolizei
role_en: Order Police officer in Warsaw responsible for repression and hostage executions
role_pl: oficer Ordnungspolizei w Warszawie odpowiedzialny za represje i egzekucje zakładników
role_de: Offizier der Ordnungspolizei in Warschau mit Verantwortung für Repressalien und Geiselerschießungen
role_ru: офицер полиции порядка в Варшаве, ответственный за репрессии и казни заложников
role_fr: officier de la police d’ordre à Varsovie responsable de la répression et de l’exécution d’otages
status_en: executed in 1947
interpretation_en: The case provides an early example of collective punishment and the hostage system being implemented by the Order Police. It does not turn Daume’s role at a particular point in time into responsibility for the whole Warsaw police apparatus.
postwar_en: Daume was extradited to Poland, sentenced to death in the Warsaw trial and executed in 1947.
limitations_en: His precise office at the time of the crime must be stated carefully, without retrospectively generalising his responsibility to the whole Warsaw police force.

name: Bruno Müller
tier_label_fr: Rouages de la guerre et de l’occupation
organization_en: Einsatzkommando 2/I, Security Police, SD and Gestapo
role_en: commander of Einsatzkommando 2/I and Security Police and SD commander in Kraków
role_pl: dowódca Einsatzkommando 2/I i komendant Sipo/SD w Krakowie
role_de: Befehlshaber des Einsatzkommandos 2/I sowie Befehlshaber der Sicherheitspolizei und des SD in Krakau
role_ru: командир айнзацкоманды 2/I и командующий полицией безопасности и СД в Кракове
role_fr: commandant de l’Einsatzkommando 2/I et commandant de la police de sûreté et du SD à Cracovie
status_en: interned and questioned after the war but not convicted for Sonderaktion Krakau
interpretation_en: Müller's office connected mobile-unit command with the on-site direction of an operation against Kraków academics. The evidence must distinguish his direction of the action from individual arrests and abuse performed by subordinates.
postwar_en: Müller did not receive a final criminal judgment for Sonderaktion Krakau and died in 1960.
limitations_en: Sources describe his personal presence and role in the arrests with differing degrees of specificity. Command of the operation should not be rewritten as personal performance of every act by his subordinates.

name: Eberhard Schöngarth
organization_en: Security Police, SD, RSHA and Einsatzkommando zur besonderen Verwendung
organization_pl: Sipo · SD · RSHA · Einsatzkommando zur besonderen Verwendung
role_en: commander of the Security Police and SD in the General Government
role_pl: dowódca Sipo i SD w Generalnym Gubernatorstwie
role_de: Befehlshaber der Sicherheitspolizei und des SD im Generalgouvernement
role_ru: командующий полицией безопасности и СД в Генерал-губернаторстве
role_fr: commandant de la police de sûreté et du SD dans le Gouvernement général
region_en: the General Government, Lviv and Galicia
status_en: convicted by a British military court for killing an Allied prisoner of war and executed in 1946
interpretation_en: Schöngarth represents the command level that expanded Security Police terror into newly occupied eastern areas. Analysis of the Lviv murders must distinguish formation of and command over the unit from orders and direct acts by particular officers.
postwar_en: British authorities tried Schöngarth for ordering the killing of an Allied prisoner of war in the Netherlands and executed him in 1946. He was not tried for the crimes committed under his command in occupied Poland and Galicia.
limitations_en: The postwar conviction concerns a different crime and must not be presented as adjudication of the Polish cases. For the Lviv professors, evidence must separate command, orders and the direct conduct of subordinate perpetrators.

name: Otto Wächter
organization_en: civil administration of the General Government, NSDAP and SS
role_en: governor of the Kraków District and later the District of Galicia
role_pl: gubernator dystryktu krakowskiego, a następnie galicyjskiego
role_de: Gouverneur des Distrikts Krakau und später des Distrikts Galizien
role_ru: губернатор Краковского округа, позднее — округа Галиция
role_fr: gouverneur du district de Cracovie puis du district de Galicie
region_en: the Kraków District, Galicia and Lviv
status_en: evaded trial while in hiding and died in Rome in 1949
interpretation_en: Wächter's responsibility was administrative and decision-making: his offices converted occupation policy into regulations, institutions and material coercion. This does not make him the direct author of every police action performed within the districts.
postwar_en: Wächter escaped arrest and hid with assistance from church-linked networks. He died in Rome in 1949 before any court could examine his responsibility.
limitations_en: Civil administration and the police acted together but had distinct commands. The governor's institutional responsibility should be shown through documented powers and measures rather than automatic attribution of every subordinate police crime.

name: Emanuel Schäfer
organization_en: Einsatzgruppe II, Gestapo, Security Police and SD
role_en: commander of Einsatzgruppe II during the invasion of Poland
role_pl: dowódca Einsatzgruppe II podczas napaści na Polskę
role_de: Befehlshaber der Einsatzgruppe II während des Überfalls auf Polen
role_ru: командир айнзацгруппы II во время вторжения в Польшу
role_fr: commandant de l’Einsatzgruppe II pendant l’invasion de la Pologne
region_en: Upper Silesia, Częstochowa and central Poland
status_en: convicted in West Germany for security-police crimes in Serbia, not separately for Einsatzgruppe II's work in Poland
interpretation_en: Schäfer filled the command link between the military advance and a mobile Security Police and SD formation in 1939. Responsibility for events in Poland must rely on Einsatzgruppe II records and cannot be inferred from his separate later conviction.
postwar_en: Schäfer was punished in West Germany for participation in security-police crimes in occupied Serbia. His command of Einsatzgruppe II in Poland was not separately adjudicated in a final judgment.
limitations_en: The geography and legal subject of the West German conviction must be stated accurately. It cannot serve as a judicial finding for every action of Einsatzgruppe II in Poland.

name: Herbert Böttcher
organization_en: SS and Police Leader apparatus in the Radom District
role_en: SS and Police Leader in the Radom District
role_pl: dowódca SS i policji w dystrykcie radomskim
role_de: SS- und Polizeiführer im Distrikt Radom
role_ru: руководитель СС и полиции в Радомском округе
role_fr: chef de la SS et de la police dans le district de Radom
region_en: the Radom District, Kielce region and Michniów
status_en: extradited to Poland, sentenced to death and executed in 1950
interpretation_en: Böttcher's responsibility lies at the regional command level over a coordinated pacification apparatus. It should be traced through orders and institutional authority without treating him as the direct member of every gendarmerie or police detachment in the field.
postwar_en: Allied authorities extradited Böttcher to Poland, where he was convicted, sentenced to death and executed.
limitations_en: Recent research has corrected earlier identifications of some units present at Michniów. The profile should retain Böttcher's regional command responsibility while reflecting those revised unit-level findings.

name: Gerulf Mayer
tier_label_fr: Rouages de la guerre et de l’occupation
organization_en: Gendarmerie and Order Police
role_en: commander of Gendarmerie-Hauptmannschaft Kielce
role_pl: dowódca Gendarmerie-Hauptmannschaft Kielce
role_de: Kommandeur der Gendarmerie-Hauptmannschaft Kielce
role_ru: командир Gendarmerie-Hauptmannschaft Kielce
role_fr: commandant de la Gendarmerie-Hauptmannschaft Kielce
region_en: the Kielce region, Michniów and Skałka Polska
status_en: sentenced in Graz in 1969 to eleven years for murders and participation in the Skałka Polska pacification
interpretation_en: Mayer's case documents a field gendarmerie commander within a continuing local pacification system, not merely one isolated event. Particular responsibility for Michniów must nonetheless follow the newer case evidence rather than older assumptions.
postwar_en: The Austrian judgment addressed murders and Skałka Polska but did not decide the whole of Mayer's activity in the Kielce region.
limitations_en: The year of Mayer's death has not been confirmed in the consulted institutional sources. Older literature stated his command role in the second phase at Michniów more firmly than newer files permit.

name: Karl Essig
tier_label_fr: Rouages de la guerre et de l’occupation
organization_en: Security Police, SD and Gestapo
role_en: head of the Security Police and SD post in Kielce
role_pl: kierownik placówki Sipo/SD w Kielcach
role_de: Leiter der Dienststelle von Sicherheitspolizei und SD in Kielce
role_ru: начальник поста полиции безопасности и СД в Кельце
role_fr: chef du poste de la police de sûreté et du SD à Kielce
region_en: Kielce, the Kielce region and Michniów
status_en: tried in West Germany in cases concerning Kielce crimes and acquitted in one proceeding; no comprehensive reckoning
interpretation_en: Essig's role shows how a local Security Police post supplied intelligence, lists and coordination to the field forces. The evidence does not justify naming him without qualification as the sole commander of the entire Michniów operation.
postwar_en: Essig faced proceedings in West Germany but was acquitted in one of them. That outcome did not determine every allegation concerning the post's work or the pacification system.
limitations_en: His year of death remains unconfirmed. Newer analysis supports a probable order for the post's participation but does not establish Essig as the unqualified sole commander of all forces at Michniów.

name: Hermann Krumey
organization_en: Central Resettlement Office, Security Police and SS
role_en: head of a Łódź Central Resettlement Office branch responsible for operational aspects of the Zamość expulsions
role_pl: kierownik placówki Centrali Przesiedleńczej w Łodzi odpowiedzialny za operacyjną stronę wysiedleń Zamojszczyzny
role_de: Leiter einer Außenstelle der Umwandererzentralstelle in Łódź, die für operative Aspekte der Vertreibungen im Zamość-Gebiet zuständig war
role_ru: начальник лодзинского отделения Центрального переселенческого управления, отвечавший за оперативные стороны выселений из Замойщины
role_fr: chef d’une antenne de l’Office central de réinstallation de Łódź, responsable d’aspects opérationnels des expulsions de Zamość
region_en: Zamość region, Łódź and the General Government
status_en: ultimately sentenced to life imprisonment in West Germany for the deportation of Hungarian Jews, not for the Zamość expulsions
interpretation_en: Krumey represents the logistical and organisational machinery that turned expulsion policy into selection, transport and family separation. His later conviction confirms responsibility in another deportation complex but was not a judgment on Zamość.
postwar_en: Krumey was first acquitted in West Germany, but retrials and appeals ended with a life sentence for participation in the deportation of Hungarian Jews. He was not convicted for the expulsions from the Zamość region.
limitations_en: The legal judgment and the Polish occupation record concern different deportation systems. His Zamość responsibility rests on organisational documents and should not be described as adjudicated by the Hungarian-deportation verdict.

name: Fritz Katzmann
organization_en: SS and Police Leader apparatus in the Radom and Galicia districts
role_en: SS and Police Leader in the Radom District and later the District of Galicia
role_pl: dowódca SS i policji w dystryktach radomskim i Galicja
role_de: SS- und Polizeiführer im Distrikt Radom und später im Distrikt Galizien
role_ru: руководитель СС и полиции в Радомском округе, позднее — в округе Галиция
role_fr: chef de la SS et de la police dans le district de Radom puis dans celui de Galicie
region_en: the Radom District, Galicia and Lviv
status_en: lived under a false identity and died in 1957 without trial
interpretation_en: Katzmann combined regional command with administrative reporting that made the extermination process visible to superiors. His responsibility must be confined to his periods and commands rather than merged with Odilo Globocnik's separate authority.
postwar_en: Katzmann escaped detection under a false identity and died in 1957 without facing a court.
limitations_en: The profile must observe the dates and boundaries of his two district commands. It should not duplicate Globocnik's biography or assign every act of police units in Galicia directly to Katzmann without a documented chain.

name: Julian Scherner
organization_en: SS and Police Leader apparatus in the Kraków District
role_en: SS and Police Leader in the Kraków District
role_pl: dowódca SS i policji w dystrykcie krakowskim
role_de: SS- und Polizeiführer im Distrikt Krakau
role_ru: руководитель СС и полиции в Краковском округе
role_fr: chef de la SS et de la police dans le district de Cracovie
region_en: Kraków, the Kraków District and Płaszów
status_en: killed near the end of the war and never tried
interpretation_en: Scherner's responsibility is that of the district SS and police commander supervising institutions that implemented deportation, ghetto liquidation and forced labour. This must not be converted into automatic personal attribution of every act by Amon Göth or other subordinates.
postwar_en: Scherner was killed at the end of the war and therefore never appeared before a court.
limitations_en: The source base should identify formal supervision and concrete orders separately. Crimes personally committed by Göth and other camp personnel cannot be assigned to Scherner merely because he occupied the higher regional office.

name: Richard Wendler
organization_en: civil administration of the General Government, NSDAP and SS
role_en: governor of the Kraków and Lublin districts
role_pl: gubernator dystryktów krakowskiego i lubelskiego
role_de: Gouverneur der Distrikte Krakau und Lublin
role_ru: губернатор Краковского и Люблинского округов
role_fr: gouverneur des districts de Cracovie et de Lublin
region_en: Kraków, Lublin, the Zamość region and Częstochowa
status_en: passed through denazification and resumed a professional career; not convicted for his occupation administration in Poland
interpretation_en: Wendler's profile shows civil district administration as a partner, and sometimes an institutional rival, of SS and police authorities. Documented disputes do not remove administrative responsibility, but they prevent treating the occupation apparatus as a single undifferentiated command.
postwar_en: Wendler regained professional standing after denazification and was not convicted for his activity as an occupation governor. He died in 1972.
limitations_en: Sources document disagreement with or attempts to restrict some SS actions; these require nuance but are not exculpatory. Aktion Zamość began before Wendler became Lublin governor and must not be attributed to him as its originator.

name: Heinz Reinefarth
organization_en: SS · Waffen-SS · Kampfgruppe Reinefarth
role_en: commander of a combat group during the suppression of the Warsaw Uprising
role_pl: dowódca grupy bojowej podczas tłumienia Powstania Warszawskiego
role_de: Kommandeur einer Kampfgruppe bei der Niederschlagung des Warschauer Aufstands
role_ru: командир боевой группы во время подавления Варшавского восстания
role_fr: commandant d’un groupe de combat pendant la répression de l’insurrection de Varsovie
region_en: Warsaw, Wola and the Old Town
status_en: not extradited or convicted
interpretation_en: The profile identifies a command link in the Wola massacre that is distinct from the roles of Erich von dem Bach-Zelewski and Oskar Dirlewanger. It does not merge Reinefarth’s own reports, orders from his superiors and acts of individual subordinate units.
postwar_en: Reinefarth was not extradited to Poland and was not convicted. He became mayor of Westerland and a member of the Schleswig-Holstein Landtag.
limitations_en: His own reports, orders issued by superiors and crimes committed by particular subordinate units must be evaluated separately.

name: Paul Otto Geibel
organization_en: SS · SS and Police Leader (SSPF), Warsaw · police
role_en: SS and Police Leader in the Warsaw district
role_pl: dowódca SS i policji w dystrykcie warszawskim
role_de: SS- und Polizeiführer im Distrikt Warschau
role_ru: командующий СС и полицией в Варшавском дистрикте
role_fr: chef de la SS et de la police dans le district de Varsovie
crime_tags_pl: Masowe egzekucje;zbrodnie w warszawskich szpitalach;Wypędzenia;Niszczenie miasta
status_en: sentenced to life imprisonment; died in prison in 1966
interpretation_en: The profile adds the district’s permanent police apparatus to the account of the combat groups used against Warsaw. It keeps actions during fighting distinct from the later systematic destruction of the city and does not assign every act of every formation to Geibel.
postwar_en: Geibel was sentenced in Poland to life imprisonment and died in prison in 1966.
limitations_en: Actions during the fighting must be distinguished from the planned destruction that followed, and every attribution requires its own evidentiary basis.

name: Bronislav Kaminski
organization_en: RONA · Waffen-Sturm-Brigade der SS RONA · Waffen-SS
organization_pl: RONA · Waffen-Sturm-Brigade der SS RONA · Waffen-SS
role_en: commander of the RONA brigade used to suppress the Warsaw Uprising
role_pl: dowódca brygady RONA użytej do tłumienia Powstania Warszawskiego
role_de: Kommandeur der bei der Niederschlagung des Warschauer Aufstands eingesetzten RONA-Brigade
role_ru: командир бригады РОНА, использованной при подавлении Варшавского восстания
role_fr: commandant de la brigade RONA employée pour réprimer l’insurrection de Varsovie
crime_tags_pl: Zbrodnie na cywilach;Gwałty;Grabież;zbrodnie w warszawskich szpitalach
status_en: killed by German authorities in August 1944; accounts of the circumstances differ
interpretation_en: The profile shows the role of an auxiliary formation and its commander in crimes committed in Ochota, including at Zieleniak. It treats Kaminski explicitly as a collaborationist formation commander operating within the German chain of command, not as a German official or as the sole perpetrator of every crime in the district.
postwar_en: Kaminski was killed by German authorities in August 1944. Official explanations and accounts of the circumstances differ.
limitations_en: This is an explicit extension of scope to the commander of a collaborationist formation within the German command chain. The official explanation and precise course of his killing differ across the sources and must not be repeated as settled fact.

name: Alfred Spilker
tier_label_fr: Rouages de la guerre et de l’occupation
organization_en: Security Police · SD · Sonderkommando Spilker
role_en: commander of Sonderkommando Spilker in Warsaw
role_pl: dowódca Sonderkommando Spilker w Warszawie
role_de: Kommandeur des Sonderkommandos Spilker in Warschau
role_ru: командир зондеркоманды Шпилькера в Варшаве
role_fr: commandant du Sonderkommando Spilker à Varsovie
status_en: died in 1945; never tried
interpretation_en: The profile identifies police selections and executions operating alongside combat units in western Warsaw. It does not transfer to Spilker every crime committed by those units or confuse his pre-uprising intelligence section with the later Sonderkommando.
postwar_en: Spilker died in 1945 and was never tried.
limitations_en: The IPN sources distinguish a pre-uprising intelligence section from the later Sonderkommando; acts must not be transferred between those structures without evidence. The precise circumstances of Spilker’s death also require further verification.

name: Walter Stamm
organization_en: Security Police · SD · Gestapo
role_en: inspector of the Security Police and SD in Warsaw and superior of the prison and execution apparatus
role_pl: inspektor Sipo i SD w Warszawie oraz zwierzchnik aparatu więzień i egzekucji
role_de: Inspekteur der Sicherheitspolizei und des SD in Warschau sowie Vorgesetzter des Gefängnis- und Exekutionsapparats
role_ru: инспектор полиции безопасности и СД в Варшаве и руководитель аппарата тюрем и казней
role_fr: inspecteur de la police de sûreté et du SD à Varsovie et supérieur de l’appareil carcéral et d’exécution
status_en: no final conviction was handed down for his activity in Warsaw
interpretation_en: The profile shows a durable prison and execution structure rather than reducing Warsaw terror to isolated operations or to the commandant of Pawiak alone. It does not attribute every act of the subordinate apparatus personally to Stamm.
postwar_en: No final conviction was handed down for Stamm’s activity in Warsaw.
limitations_en: The titles and scope of his post vary in the sources. The chronology of the IdS, BdS and KdS structures in Warsaw must therefore be kept visible rather than collapsed into a single unchanging office.

name: Max Frauendorfer
organization_en: General Government labour administration and NSDAP
role_en: head of the Main Labour Department of the General Government
role_pl: kierownik Głównego Wydziału Pracy w rządzie Generalnego Gubernatorstwa
role_de: Leiter der Hauptabteilung Arbeit des Generalgouvernements
role_ru: начальник Главного отдела труда Генерал-губернаторства
role_fr: chef du département principal du Travail du Gouvernement général
region_en: the General Government and the German Reich
status_en: interned but not convicted for organising forced labour in the General Government; later resumed his career
interpretation_en: Frauendorfer's agency was administrative and logistical: his department organised the machinery that classified, recruited and transferred forced labourers. It must be distinguished from police units that conducted raids and from Fritz Sauckel's central Reich authority.
postwar_en: Frauendorfer was interned after Germany's defeat, then released without conviction for the forced-labour administration in occupied Poland. He continued a professional career in West Germany.
limitations_en: His exact competencies changed over time and should be dated where individual measures are discussed. Administrative planning and police coercion formed one mechanism but remained separate institutional responsibilities.

name: Werner Lorenz
organization_en: Volksdeutsche Mittelstelle, SS and Reich Commissioner for the Strengthening of Germandom apparatus
role_en: head of the SS Main Office Volksdeutsche Mittelstelle (VoMi)
role_pl: szef Hauptamt Volksdeutsche Mittelstelle
role_de: Leiter des SS-Hauptamtes Volksdeutsche Mittelstelle (VoMi)
role_ru: руководитель Главного управления СС Volksdeutsche Mittelstelle (VoMi)
role_fr: chef de l’office principal SS Volksdeutsche Mittelstelle (VoMi)
region_en: territories annexed to the Reich, the Zamość region and occupied Europe
region_pl: ziemie wcielone do Rzeszy · Zamojszczyzna · Europa okupowana
status_en: sentenced to twenty years in the RuSHA Trial; sentence reduced and released in 1955
interpretation_en: Lorenz occupied the organisational level that translated SS settlement policy into transfers and support for ethnic-German colonisation. His office's responsibility must be distinguished from the separate functions of RuSHA, RKFDV and the Central Resettlement Office.
postwar_en: Lorenz's sentence was later reduced, and he was released from Landsberg prison in 1955. He died in 1974.
limitations_en: VoMi, RuSHA, RKFDV and the Central Resettlement Office had overlapping but non-identical functions. Simplified accounts often merge them, so particular actions require an office-specific documentary link.

name: Otto Hofmann
organization_en: SS Race and Settlement Main Office and RKFDV apparatus
role_en: head of the SS Race and Settlement Main Office (RuSHA)
role_pl: szef Głównego Urzędu Rasy i Osadnictwa SS
role_de: Leiter des SS-Rasse- und Siedlungshauptamtes (RuSHA)
role_ru: руководитель Главного управления СС по вопросам расы и поселения (RuSHA)
role_fr: chef de l’Office central SS pour la race et le peuplement (RuSHA)
region_en: territories annexed to the Reich and occupied Poland
region_pl: ziemie wcielone do Rzeszy · okupowana Polska
status_en: sentenced to twenty-five years in the RuSHA Trial; released in 1954
interpretation_en: Hofmann's responsibility lay in the criteria and institutional machinery of racial selection, which supported expulsion, Germanisation and the removal of children. The wider child-abduction system involved several offices and cannot be reduced to RuSHA alone.
postwar_en: Hofmann's prison term was shortened during sentence reviews, and he was released in 1954. He lived until 1982.
limitations_en: The profile must separate Hofmann's RuSHA tenure from his later posts. Responsibility for abducting and Germanising children was distributed among RuSHA, RKFDV, VoMi, welfare and police institutions.

name: Kajetan Mühlmann
organization_en: Dienststelle Mühlmann, General Government administration and SS
organization_pl: Dienststelle Mühlmann · rząd Generalnego Gubernatorstwa · SS
role_en: special commissioner for the seizure of works of art in the General Government
role_pl: specjalny pełnomocnik do zabezpieczania dzieł sztuki w Generalnym Gubernatorstwie
role_de: Sonderbeauftragter für die Beschlagnahme von Kunstwerken im Generalgouvernement
role_ru: специальный уполномоченный по изъятию произведений искусства в Генерал-губернаторстве
role_fr: commissaire spécial chargé de la saisie des œuvres d’art dans le Gouvernement général
region_en: the General Government, Kraków and Warsaw
status_en: questioned by the Allies and escaped internment; never tried for the plunder carried out in Poland
interpretation_en: Mühlmann connected expert knowledge, inventories, transport and administrative authority in a planned mechanism of cultural dispossession. Responsibility should follow documented seizures by his office and not be expanded to every act of wartime looting in Poland.
postwar_en: Allied authorities questioned Mühlmann about the plundered collections. He escaped custody and died in 1958 without a criminal judgment for the seizures in occupied Poland.
limitations_en: The perpetrators' term securing must appear only as a historical label and must be explained as confiscation and plunder. Individual objects and collections should be attributed through surviving inventories rather than assumed from his office title.

name: Peter Paulsen
tier_label_fr: Rouages de la guerre et de l’occupation
organization_en: Sonderkommando Paulsen, SS-Ahnenerbe and RSHA
role_en: SS archaeologist and commander of Sonderkommando Paulsen
role_pl: archeolog SS kierujący Sonderkommando Paulsen
role_de: SS-Archäologe und Befehlshaber des Sonderkommandos Paulsen
role_ru: археолог СС и командир Sonderkommando Paulsen
role_fr: archéologue SS et commandant du Sonderkommando Paulsen
region_en: Warsaw, the General Government and territories annexed to the Reich
status_en: not convicted for Sonderkommando Paulsen's activity and continued an academic career after the war
interpretation_en: Paulsen represents the field implementation of cultural seizure by specialists: identifying, taking and moving collections. His command should not be equated with all Ahnenerbe activity or every German cultural-plunder office.
postwar_en: No court convicted Paulsen for the work of his Sonderkommando. He continued his scholarly career and died in 1985.
limitations_en: The unit's institutional subordination changed over time. Its acts must be attributed to the Sonderkommando on documentary grounds and not generalised to the entire Ahnenerbe.

name: Erwin Wester
tier_label_fr: Rouages de la guerre et de l’occupation
organization_en: Stanislau Special Court and the German judiciary in the General Government
organization_pl: Sondergericht Stanislau · niemiecki wymiar sprawiedliwości w GG · NSDAP
role_en: presiding judge of the German Special Court in Stanislau
role_pl: przewodniczący niemieckiego Sądu Specjalnego w Stanisławowie
role_de: Vorsitzender Richter des deutschen Sondergerichts in Stanislau
role_ru: председательствующий судья германского особого суда в Станиславе
role_fr: président du tribunal spécial allemand de Stanislau
region_en: Stanislau and the District of Galicia
status_en: extradited to Poland and indicted, but died in prison in July 1948 before trial
interpretation_en: Wester exercised direct adjudicative power within a special court designed to enforce occupation policy. Responsibility must be built from surviving judgments, while the incomplete archive prevents extrapolating a comprehensive number of sentences.
postwar_en: Wester was transferred to Polish custody and charged, but his death in prison in July 1948 meant that no trial or judgment followed.
limitations_en: Only part of the court's case law survives, so a precise total of his death sentences cannot be inferred. The indictment, historical findings and absence of a final judicial verdict must be clearly distinguished.

name: Horst Neubauer
tier_label_fr: Rouages de la guerre et de l’occupation
organization_en: Litzmannstadt Special Court and the German occupation judiciary
role_en: judge of the German Special Court in Łódź
role_pl: sędzia niemieckiego Sądu Specjalnego w Łodzi
role_de: Richter des deutschen Sondergerichts in Łódź
role_ru: судья германского особого суда в Лодзи
role_fr: juge au tribunal spécial allemand de Łódź
status_en: not convicted after the war for judgments delivered in occupied Łódź
interpretation_en: Neubauer shows personal judicial agency inside the occupation's special-court machinery. The classification follows the function and power to decide cases, not an unverified ranking based on the number of sentences.
postwar_en: Neubauer lived until 1981 without a conviction for his decisions in occupied Łódź.
limitations_en: The current sources establish his qualification for inclusion but not a complete biography or exhaustive judgment list. Further work should consult the cited study by Holger Schlüter and personnel records.

name: Wolfram von Richthofen
organization_en: Luftwaffe, Air Fleet 4 and VIII Air Corps
role_en: Luftwaffe commander directing air operations during the invasion of Poland
role_pl: dowódca Luftwaffe kierujący działaniami lotniczymi podczas napaści na Polskę
role_de: Luftwaffenbefehlshaber, der während des Überfalls auf Polen Luftoperationen leitete
role_ru: командующий люфтваффе, руководивший воздушными операциями во время вторжения в Польшу
role_fr: commandant de la Luftwaffe dirigeant les opérations aériennes pendant l’invasion de la Pologne
region_en: Wieluń and southern and central Poland
status_en: died in American captivity in 1945 and was never tried
interpretation_en: Richthofen's profile addresses operational command responsibility for air violence against civilians during the invasion. It does not assume that every Luftwaffe attack in southern or central Poland was personally selected by him.
postwar_en: Richthofen was captured by American forces and died in captivity in 1945. He was never tried.
limitations_en: The legal assessment of the Wieluń bombing remains disputed. Conclusions should rest on operational orders, flight records and the commanders' knowledge of the targets rather than journalistic shorthand.

name: Alexander Löhr
organization_en: Luftwaffe, Air Fleet 4 and Wehrmacht
role_en: commander of Air Fleet 4 during the invasion of Poland
role_pl: dowódca Luftflotte 4 podczas napaści na Polskę
role_de: Befehlshaber der Luftflotte 4 während des Überfalls auf Polen
role_ru: командующий 4-м воздушным флотом во время вторжения в Польшу
role_fr: commandant de la 4e flotte aérienne pendant l’invasion de la Pologne
region_en: Wieluń and southern and central Poland
status_en: convicted by a Yugoslav court for crimes in the Balkans and executed in 1947; the judgment did not address bombing in Poland
interpretation_en: Löhr's profile identifies the senior air-fleet command level rather than placing responsibility only on aircrews or one subordinate corps commander. The Polish bombing record must be analysed separately from the Balkan crimes adjudicated after the war.
postwar_en: The Yugoslav proceedings ended in a death sentence and execution in 1947. They did not constitute a judicial reckoning with Air Fleet 4's bombing operations in Poland.
limitations_en: The legal character of the Wieluń bombing and the commander's knowledge require careful use of operational orders, flight logs and target intelligence. The postwar Balkan judgment must not be misrepresented as a verdict on the Polish campaign.

name: Otto Bradfisch
organization_en: Gestapo · Security Police and SD · Einsatzkommando 8
role_en: head of the Łódź Gestapo office and former commander of Einsatzkommando 8
role_pl: szef placówki Gestapo w Łodzi i były dowódca Einsatzkommando 8
role_de: Leiter der Staatspolizeistelle Litzmannstadt (Łódź) und ehemaliger Führer des Einsatzkommandos 8
role_ru: начальник отделения гестапо в Лодзи и бывший командир айнзацкоманды 8
role_fr: chef du service de la Gestapo de Łódź et ancien commandant de l’Einsatzkommando 8
region_en: Łódź, the Wartheland and the Chełmno killing centre
region_pl: Łódź · Kraj Warty · Chełmno nad Nerem
status_en: convicted; released in 1969
interpretation_en: This profile identifies the level at which a regional police headquarters converted a decision to murder into deportation timetables, staffing and field operations. It does not attribute every crime committed by the Łódź office to Bradfisch personally.
postwar_en: In 1961 a Munich court sentenced Bradfisch to ten years’ imprisonment for his part in the crimes of Einsatzkommando 8. In 1963 a Hanover court imposed a thirteen-year sentence for complicity in the deportation and murder of Jews from Łódź. The sentences ran concurrently; he was released in 1969.
limitations_en: The Hanover judgment distinguished Bradfisch’s responsibility from that of department head Günter Fuchs. This profile preserves that distinction and does not equate command responsibility with personally carrying out every act.

name: Jakob Lölgen
tier_label_fr: Rouages de la guerre et de l’occupation
organization_en: Gestapo in Gdańsk · Einsatzkommando 16
role_en: commander of an Einsatzkommando 16 detachment in Bydgoszcz
role_pl: dowódca wydzielonego komanda Einsatzkommando 16 w Bydgoszczy
role_de: Führer des Teilkommandos Bydgoszcz des Einsatzkommandos 16
role_ru: командир отряда айнзацкоманды 16 в Быдгоще
role_fr: commandant d’un détachement de l’Einsatzkommando 16 à Bydgoszcz
status_en: acquitted in 1966
interpretation_en: The case shows a local link connecting lists, arrests, selection and execution. It does not transfer to Lölgen the entire responsibility of the Selbstschutz or of every formation operating in Bydgoszcz.
postwar_en: After the war Lölgen returned to criminal-police work in Trier. He stood trial in Munich with Horst Eichler in 1966 and was acquitted.
limitations_en: The candidate had been deferred in wave 3. Publication became possible because new and independent material was found: an IPN description of the judgment files, a later analysis of the trial and an IPN educational publication. Variant spellings of his surname are retained as aliases.

name: Helmut Bischoff
organization_en: Gestapo · Einsatzkommando 1/IV · Security Police and SD
role_en: commander of Einsatzkommando 1/IV and head of the Gestapo in Poznań
role_pl: dowódca Einsatzkommando 1/IV i szef Gestapo w Poznaniu
role_de: Führer des Einsatzkommandos 1/IV und Leiter der Gestapo in Poznań
role_ru: командир айнзацкоманды 1/IV и начальник гестапо в Познани
role_fr: commandant de l’Einsatzkommando 1/IV et chef de la Gestapo à Poznań
status_en: no final conviction
interpretation_en: His career connects a mobile task force with a regional Gestapo headquarters and a prison-and-execution system. Responsibility is described through office, orders and supervision, not by assigning every victim of Fort VII to a single person.
postwar_en: After a period in Soviet captivity Bischoff returned to West Germany. Proceedings concerning Mittelbau-Dora, the Einsatzgruppen and Poznań did not produce a final conviction; cases were postponed or discontinued, in part on health grounds.
limitations_en: The case files cover many people and locations. The existence of an investigation is not treated here as proof that Bischoff personally carried out every killing.

name: Herbert Lange
organization_en: Security Police and SD · Sonderkommando Lange · Kulmhof
organization_pl: Sipo i SD · Sonderkommando Lange · Kulmhof
role_en: commander of Sonderkommando Lange and first commandant of the Chełmno killing centre
role_pl: dowódca Sonderkommando Lange i pierwszy komendant Kulmhof
role_de: Führer des Sonderkommandos Lange und erster Kommandant der Vernichtungsstätte Chełmno
role_ru: командир зондеркоманды Ланге и первый комендант центра уничтожения Хелмно (Кульмхоф)
role_fr: commandant du Sonderkommando Lange et premier commandant du centre de mise à mort de Chełmno
region_en: the Wartheland, Fort VII and Chełmno
region_pl: Kraj Warty · Fort VII · Chełmno nad Nerem
status_en: killed in 1945; never tried
interpretation_en: The profile traces the transfer of personnel, technology and practice from the killing of institutionalised patients to a purpose-built killing centre. It places Lange within the SS and police chain in the Wartheland rather than presenting the process as the work of one man.
postwar_en: Lange was killed during the battle for Berlin in April 1945 and never stood trial.
limitations_en: Estimates for individual killing operations and the precise composition of the unit vary. The profile therefore centres on the documented command role and the continuity of the mechanism.

name: Max Grosskopf
organization_en: Security Police and SD · Gestapo · KdS Krakau
organization_pl: Sipo i SD · Gestapo · KdS Krakau
role_en: commander of the Security Police and SD in the Kraków district
role_pl: komendant Sipo i SD w dystrykcie krakowskim
role_de: Kommandeur der Sicherheitspolizei und des SD im Distrikt Krakau
role_ru: командир полиции безопасности и СД в дистрикте Краков
role_fr: commandant de la police de sûreté et du SD dans le district de Cracovie
status_en: died by suicide in 1945; never tried
interpretation_en: Grosskopf’s responsibility follows from his direction of a regional police apparatus. It does not rest on an assumption that he personally carried out all crimes committed by that apparatus.
postwar_en: Grosskopf died by suicide in April 1945. A court declared him dead in 1948; he was never tried.
limitations_en: The candidate had been deferred in wave 3. A peer-reviewed study published in 2025 and a separate IPN publication provided the new independent basis required for publication.

name: Rudolf Mildner
organization_en: Gestapo in Katowice · Security Police and SD · police summary court
organization_pl: Gestapo Katowice · Sipo i SD · policyjny sąd doraźny
role_en: head of the Gestapo in Katowice and presiding officer of the police summary court at Auschwitz
role_pl: szef Gestapo w Katowicach i przewodniczący policyjnego sądu doraźnego w Auschwitz
role_de: Leiter der Gestapo in Katowice und Vorsitzender des Polizeistandgerichts in Auschwitz
role_ru: начальник гестапо в Катовице и председатель полицейского чрезвычайного суда в Аушвице
role_fr: chef de la Gestapo de Katowice et président du tribunal sommaire de police à Auschwitz
status_en: never tried; later fate unresolved
interpretation_en: The profile shows how a façade of judicial procedure operated inside the police apparatus: decision, nominal hearing and immediate execution formed a single chain of repression.
postwar_en: Mildner was questioned as a witness during the Nuremberg trials and later released from internment. Subsequent investigations did not lead to a trial. His fate after the mid-1970s remains unresolved.
limitations_en: Named records do not survive for every sentence imposed by the summary court. The profile distinguishes Mildner’s role as presiding officer from the acts of the camp personnel who carried out executions.

name: Maximilian Grabner
organization_en: Gestapo · Political Department of Auschwitz concentration camp
role_en: head of the Gestapo Political Department at Auschwitz concentration camp
role_pl: szef Wydziału Politycznego Gestapo w KL Auschwitz
role_de: Leiter der Politischen Abteilung der Gestapo im Konzentrationslager Auschwitz
role_ru: начальник Политического отдела гестапо в концентрационном лагере Аушвиц
role_fr: chef du Département politique de la Gestapo au camp de concentration d’Auschwitz
status_en: executed in 1948
interpretation_en: The profile separates the Gestapo’s Political Department from the camp commandant’s office and explains how the two structures cooperated in investigations, selections and executions.
postwar_en: Grabner was extradited to Poland in 1947, sentenced to death in the first Auschwitz trial and executed in January 1948.
limitations_en: Not every crime committed by the Political Department can be attributed personally to its chief. The profile uses trial records to distinguish the scope of his leadership from individual acts.

name: Friedrich Uebelhoer
organization_en: Wartheland administration · Kalisz administrative district
role_en: president of the Kalisz administrative district and author of the order establishing the Łódź ghetto
role_pl: prezydent rejencji kaliskiej, autor zarządzenia o utworzeniu getta łódzkiego
role_de: Regierungspräsident des Regierungsbezirks Kalisz und Urheber der Anordnung zur Errichtung des Ghettos Łódź
role_ru: президент административного округа Калиш и автор распоряжения о создании Лодзинского гетто
role_fr: président du district administratif de Kalisz et auteur de l’ordre créant le ghetto de Łódź
region_en: Łódź, the Kalisz district and the Wartheland
status_en: missing; later declared dead
interpretation_en: The profile shows that the ghetto was created through an administrative act and cooperation among civil offices, police and municipal authorities. Uebelhoer is documented as the author and issuer of a key decision, not as the sole creator of the entire system.
postwar_en: Uebelhoer disappeared near the end of the war. He was declared dead in 1950 and never stood trial.
limitations_en: The order and Uebelhoer’s office are well documented; his final fate is not. The founding act is not equated with personal direction of every later deportation.

name: Werner Ventzki
tier_label_fr: Rouages de la guerre et de l’occupation
organization_en: Łódź municipal administration · NSDAP · SS
role_en: lord mayor of occupied Łódź and an official of the Wartheland administration
role_pl: nadburmistrz okupacyjnej Łodzi i urzędnik administracji Kraju Warty
role_de: Oberbürgermeister des besetzten Łódź und Beamter der Verwaltung des Reichsgaus Wartheland
role_ru: обер-бургомистр оккупированной Лодзи и чиновник администрации Вартеланда
role_fr: maire de Łódź occupée et fonctionnaire de l’administration du Wartheland
status_en: never tried; continued an administrative career in West Germany
interpretation_en: The profile exposes the municipal level of occupation, where racial policy became housing administration, welfare policy, expropriation and services connected with the ghetto. Ventzki’s responsibility is confined to competencies supported by documents and research.
postwar_en: After the war Ventzki worked in the West German administration, including on matters concerning expellees. Proceedings did not lead to an indictment or trial. He died in 2004.
limitations_en: Authority over the ghetto was divided among the municipality, the ghetto administration, the Gestapo and the Wartheland leadership. The profile does not assign to Ventzki acts that belonged exclusively to those separate structures.

name: Walter Pelzhausen
tier_label_fr: Rouages de la guerre et de l’occupation
organization_en: Radogoszcz police prison · German police
role_en: commandant of the Radogoszcz police prison in Łódź
role_pl: komendant więzienia policyjnego Radogoszcz w Łodzi
role_de: Kommandant des Polizeigefängnisses Radogoszcz in Łódź
role_ru: комендант полицейской тюрьмы Радогощ в Лодзи
role_fr: commandant de la prison de police de Radogoszcz à Łódź
status_en: executed in 1948
interpretation_en: The case connects routine prison violence with the final attempt to destroy prisoners and evidence. The commandant’s responsibility is described alongside the acts of identified guards, not in place of them.
postwar_en: Pelzhausen was tried in Łódź in 1947, sentenced to death and executed in March 1948.
limitations_en: The number of people inside the building and the precise course of the fire are reconstructed from testimony and trial records. Divergent totals are not used to rank perpetrators.

name: Heinz Auerswald
tier_label_fr: Rouages de la guerre et de l’occupation
organization_en: Warsaw district administration · Kommissar für den jüdischen Wohnbezirk
organization_pl: administracja dystryktu warszawskiego · Kommissar für den jüdischen Wohnbezirk
role_en: commissioner for the Jewish residential district in Warsaw
role_pl: komisarz do spraw dzielnicy żydowskiej w Warszawie
role_de: Kommissar für den jüdischen Wohnbezirk in Warschau
role_ru: комиссар еврейского жилого района в Варшаве
role_fr: commissaire chargé du quartier résidentiel juif de Varsovie
status_en: investigated but never tried; died in 1970
interpretation_en: The profile demonstrates how isolation and destruction were sustained by daily administration, not only by the highly visible deportation operations.
postwar_en: Auerswald worked as a lawyer in Hanover. He was investigated during the 1960s but died in 1970 before an indictment was filed.
limitations_en: The commissioner’s powers overlapped with those of the district governor, police and SS. Only regulations and practices documented as belonging to Auerswald’s office are attributed to him.

name: Hermann Worthoff
tier_label_fr: Rouages de la guerre et de l’occupation
organization_en: Gestapo in Lublin · KdS Lublin · Operation Reinhard
role_en: head of the Jewish affairs section of the Lublin Gestapo and commander of a liquidation unit
role_pl: kierownik referatu żydowskiego Gestapo w Lublinie i dowódca komanda likwidacyjnego
role_de: Leiter des Judenreferats der Gestapo in Lublin und Führer eines Liquidierungskommandos
role_ru: начальник реферата по «еврейским делам» люблинского гестапо и командир подразделения по ликвидации гетто
role_fr: chef de la section des affaires juives de la Gestapo de Lublin et commandant d’une unité de liquidation
status_en: sentenced to eight years in 1975
interpretation_en: Worthoff represents a specialist section that joined record-keeping, deportation and operational violence. The profile does not extend his responsibility to the whole of Operation Reinhard.
postwar_en: Worthoff lived under a false name until 1953. In 1975 the Wiesbaden Regional Court sentenced him to eight years’ imprisonment for assisting in the murder of residents of the Lublin ghetto.
limitations_en: The judgment addressed specified acts and proven forms of assistance. Disputed details of individual shootings are identified as uncertainty rather than presented as established fact.

name: Hans Krüger
organization_en: Security Police and SD · Gestapo in Stanisławów
role_en: head of the Security Police office in Stanisławów
role_pl: szef placówki Sipo w Stanisławowie
role_de: Leiter der Dienststelle der Sicherheitspolizei in Stanisławów
role_ru: начальник отделения полиции безопасности в Станиславове
role_fr: chef du service de la police de sûreté à Stanisławów
region_en: Stanisławów and the District of Galicia
status_en: life sentence; released in 1986
interpretation_en: The profile distinguishes crimes proved against Krüger at trial from the broader history of the Holocaust in the District of Galicia.
postwar_en: In 1968 the Münster Regional Court sentenced Krüger to life imprisonment for murder and assistance in murder. He was released in 1986 and died two years later.
limitations_en: Court records cover only part of the office’s crimes. The number of victims across the entire region is not used as a measure of one individual’s guilt.

name: Franz Konrad
tier_label_fr: Rouages de la guerre et de l’occupation
organization_en: SS · Werterfassung · SSPF Warsaw
role_en: head of the Werterfassung property-seizure apparatus in the Warsaw ghetto
role_pl: kierownik Werterfassung — aparatu grabieży mienia w getcie warszawskim
role_de: Leiter des Apparats zur Werterfassung und Beschlagnahme im Warschauer Ghetto
role_ru: начальник аппарата учёта и конфискации ценностей в Варшавском гетто
role_fr: chef de l’appareil de saisie des biens Werterfassung dans le ghetto de Varsovie
status_en: executed in 1952
interpretation_en: The profile places plunder inside the destruction process: from searching homes through warehousing to transferring goods. It does not reduce the economic mechanism to Konrad’s personal corruption.
postwar_en: Konrad was tried in Warsaw with Jürgen Stroop, sentenced to death and executed on 6 March 1952.
limitations_en: Some testimony describes personal theft by Konrad. The profile separates those acts from the institutional plunder documented in trial records and scholarship.

name: Gustav Abb
tier_label_fr: Rouages de la guerre et de l’occupation
organization_en: Hauptverwaltung der Bibliotheken · General Government administration
organization_pl: Hauptverwaltung der Bibliotheken · administracja Generalnego Gubernatorstwa
role_en: head of the Main Administration of Libraries in the General Government
role_pl: kierownik Głównego Zarządu Bibliotek w Generalnym Gubernatorstwie
role_de: Leiter der Hauptverwaltung der Bibliotheken im Generalgouvernement
role_ru: начальник Главного управления библиотек в Генерал-губернаторстве
role_fr: chef de l’Administration principale des bibliothèques du Gouvernement général
region_en: the General Government, Warsaw and Kraków
status_en: killed in 1945; never tried
