name: Walter Adolf Langleist
organization_en: SS · Buchenwald · Majdanek · Dachau/Kaufering · Mühldorf
organization_pl: SS · KL Buchenwald · KL Majdanek · KL Dachau/Kaufering · Mühldorf
role_en: Commandant of the Kaufering subcamp complex and commander of SS guard personnel.
role_pl: komendant kompleksu podobozów Kaufering KL Dachau
role_de: Kommandant des Kauferinger Außenlagerkomplexes und Führer von SS-Wachpersonal.
role_ru: Комендант комплекса филиалов Кауферинг и командир охранного персонала СС.
role_fr: Commandant du complexe de kommandos extérieurs de Kaufering et chef de gardes SS.
status_en: Sentenced to death in the main Dachau trial; executed on 28 May 1946.
interpretation_en: Responsibility rests on his command office and the judicial finding of participation in the common design; the profile does not assign a specific individual killing without evidence.
crime_profile_pl: Jako komendant Kaufering uczestniczył w kierowaniu kompleksem pracy przymusowej; sąd uznał go winnym udziału we wspólnym planie obejmującym zabójstwa, pobicia, tortury, głodzenie i nadużycia.
postwar_en: A U.S. military court sentenced him to death by hanging on 13 December 1945; the sentence was carried out at Landsberg on 28 May 1946.
limitations_en: No safely licensed portrait has been identified for publication; the profile remains without an image pending a separate rights review. The group judgment does not individualize every act of violence at Kaufering.

name: Walter Quakernack
organization_en: Auschwitz Political Department · Laurahütte · Hannover-Mühlenberg · SS
organization_pl: Wydział Polityczny KL Auschwitz · Laurahütte · Hannover-Mühlenberg · SS
role_en: Auschwitz Political Department officer, subcamp commandant and evacuation-march commander.
role_pl: komendant podobozów Laurahütte i Hannover-Mühlenberg
role_de: Mitarbeiter der Politischen Abteilung Auschwitz, Außenlagerkommandant und Führer eines Evakuierungsmarsches.
role_ru: Сотрудник Политического отдела Аушвица, комендант филиалов и командир эвакуационного марша.
role_fr: Agent de la Section politique d’Auschwitz, commandant de kommandos extérieurs et chef d’une marche d’évacuation.
region_en: Auschwitz, Laurahütte, Hannover-Mühlenberg and the route to Bergen-Belsen
region_pl: Auschwitz · Laurahütte · Hannover-Mühlenberg · marsz do Bergen-Belsen
status_en: Sentenced to death in the Belsen Trial; executed on 11 October 1946.
interpretation_en: The profile separates Quakernack's documented acts from the full toll of crimes at Auschwitz and on the evacuation march.
crime_profile_pl: Świadkowie opisali, że strzelał do więźniów i zarządzał zabijanie osób niezdolnych iść dalej podczas ewakuacji Hannover-Mühlenberg; sąd uznał tę odpowiedzialność.
postwar_en: A British military court sentenced him to death; after clemency was refused, he was hanged at Hameln on 11 October 1946.
limitations_en: No safely licensed portrait has been identified for publication; the profile remains without an image pending a separate rights review. The witness record does not establish a reliable total of his personal victims.

name: Walter Schellenberg
organization_en: RSHA Amt VI · SD · SS
role_en: Chief of RSHA Amt VI, the SD foreign intelligence service.
role_pl: szef Amt VI RSHA, zagranicznego wywiadu SD
role_de: Chef des Amtes VI im RSHA, des SD-Auslandsnachrichtendienstes.
role_ru: Начальник VI управления РСХА, внешней разведки СД.
role_fr: Chef de l’Amt VI du RSHA, le renseignement extérieur du SD.
region_en: Berlin, German-occupied Soviet territory and the foreign intelligence network
region_pl: Berlin · okupowany ZSRR · zagraniczna sieć wywiadowcza
crime_tags_pl: RSHA;Sipo i SD;Jeńcy wojenni;Egzekucje bez sądu
status_en: Sentenced to six years in the Ministries Trial; released in December 1950.
interpretation_en: The profile records the knowledge and leadership responsibility found by the court; it does not claim that Schellenberg personally carried out executions.
crime_profile_pl: W sprawie operacji Zeppelin trybunał ustalił, że Amt VI decydował o losie nieprzydatnych agentów rekrutowanych wśród radzieckich jeńców, z których co najmniej dwustu stracono, oraz że Schellenberg znał tę praktykę.
postwar_en: In 1949 he was convicted on Counts V and VIII and sentenced to six years, credited from 17 June 1945; he was released in December 1950 and died in Turin on 31 March 1952.
limitations_en: No safely licensed portrait has been identified for publication; the profile remains without an image pending a separate rights review. The judgment did not attribute the personal execution of every Zeppelin victim to him.

name: Walter Sonntag
organization_en: Ravensbrück concentration camp · Sachsenhausen concentration camp · SS
role_en: Garrison physician and chief camp physician at Ravensbrück.
role_pl: lekarz garnizonowy i naczelny lekarz obozowy KL Ravensbrück
role_de: Standortarzt und leitender Lagerarzt im KZ Ravensbrück.
role_ru: Гарнизонный и главный лагерный врач в Равенсбрюке.
role_fr: Médecin de garnison et médecin-chef du camp de Ravensbrück.
status_en: Sentenced to death in the fourth Ravensbrück trial; executed on 17 September 1948.
interpretation_en: The profile joins only conduct and offices supported by the trial record and does not assign every medical crime at Ravensbrück to Sonntag.
crime_profile_pl: Zeznania przypisywały mu ciężkie pobicia więźniarek, śmiertelne zastrzyki i udział w selekcjach Aktion 14f13 kierujących więźniarki do Bernburga.
postwar_en: A British military court sentenced him to death on 4 June 1948; he was hanged at Hameln on 17 September 1948.
limitations_en: No safely licensed portrait has been identified for publication; the profile remains without an image pending a separate rights review. The testimony does not support a reliable total of all his victims.

name: Wilhelm Beiglböck
organization_en: Luftwaffe Medical Service; Dachau concentration camp
role_en: physician in charge of seawater experiments on prisoners at Dachau
role_pl: lekarz kierujący eksperymentami z wodą morską na więźniach KL Dachau
role_de: verantwortlicher Arzt der Meerwasserexperimente an Häftlingen im KZ Dachau
role_ru: врач, руководивший опытами с морской водой над заключёнными Дахау
role_fr: médecin responsable des expériences sur l’eau de mer imposées aux détenus de Dachau
status_en: Sentenced in 1947 to 15 years in prison; the term was reduced to 10 years and he was released early in 1951.
interpretation_en: The profile attributes his direct direction of the documented experiments and the responsibility established by the judgment, without assigning unproved deaths to him.
crime_profile_pl: Jako lekarz Luftwaffe kierował w 1944 r. eksperymentami z wodą morską na 40 więźniach KL Dachau. W procesie lekarzy skazano go na 15 lat więzienia; karę zmniejszono do 10 lat i zwolniono go przedterminowo w 1951 r.
postwar_en: The 15-year term was reduced to 10 years; after early release in 1951 he resumed medical work, and the new investigation of 1959–1960 was discontinued.
limitations_en: No separate victim total or causal link to particular deaths is asserted beyond the cited findings. No portrait with clearly documented publication rights was found.

name: Wilhelm Boger
organization_en: SS; Gestapo; Political Department of Auschwitz
organization_pl: SS; Gestapo; Wydział Polityczny KL Auschwitz
role_en: officer in the investigation and interrogation section of the Auschwitz Political Department
role_pl: funkcjonariusz sekcji śledczej i przesłuchań Wydziału Politycznego KL Auschwitz
role_de: Angehöriger des Ermittlungs- und Vernehmungsreferats der Politischen Abteilung in Auschwitz
role_ru: сотрудник следственно-допросного подразделения Политического отдела Освенцима
role_fr: agent de la section des enquêtes et interrogatoires du département politique d’Auschwitz
status_en: Sentenced in 1965 to life imprisonment plus 5 years; he died in custody on 3 April 1977.
interpretation_en: The profile distinguishes Boger’s office in the camp political police from the acts individually proved at trial and does not assign every crime of the Political Department to him.
crime_profile_pl: W Wydziale Politycznym KL Auschwitz kierował sekcją dochodzeń i przesłuchań. Sąd frankfurcki skazał go za 5 zabójstw, współsprawstwo 109 zabójstw i pomocnictwo przy 1 010 zabójstwach na dożywocie oraz 5 lat; zmarł w więzieniu.
postwar_en: Arrested in October 1958, he was sentenced in 1965 to life imprisonment plus 5 years and died in custody on 3 April 1977.
limitations_en: The figures are legal categories of conduct covered by the judgment, not a separate victim total for this profile. No portrait with clearly documented publication rights was found.

name: Wilhelm Dörr
organization_en: SS; Kleinbodungen subcamp; Bergen-Belsen concentration camp
role_en: deputy commander of the Kleinbodungen subcamp and its evacuation column to Bergen-Belsen
role_pl: zastępca dowódcy podobozu Kleinbodungen i kolumny ewakuacyjnej do Bergen-Belsen
role_de: Stellvertreter des Kommandoführers in Kleinbodungen und der Räumungskolonne nach Bergen-Belsen
role_ru: заместитель командира подлагеря Кляйнбодунген и эвакуационной колонны в Берген-Бельзен
role_fr: adjoint du chef du camp annexe de Kleinbodungen et de sa colonne d’évacuation vers Bergen-Belsen
status_en: Convicted in the Belsen Trial and executed on 13 December 1945.
interpretation_en: The profile attributes the function and conduct documented in the trial record, notes the defence position and bases the legal outcome on the judgment.
crime_profile_pl: Jako zastępca dowódcy Kleinbodungen uczestniczył w kwietniu 1945 r. w ewakuacji więźniów do Bergen-Belsen; raport procesu przytacza zeznania o strzelaniu przez niego do więźniów. Skazany na śmierć w procesie Bergen-Belsen, został stracony 13 grudnia 1945 r.
postwar_en: A British military court convicted him in 1945; the death sentence was carried out at Hameln on 13 December 1945.
limitations_en: No victim total is calculated from conflicting testimony, and not every act of the column or camp staff is assigned to Dörr. No portrait with clearly documented publication rights was found.

name: Wilhelm Simon
organization_en: SS; Mittelbau-Dora concentration camp
role_en: labour-allocation leader responsible for assigning prisoner labour at Mittelbau-Dora
role_pl: Arbeitseinsatzführer odpowiedzialny za przydział pracy więźniów w KL Mittelbau-Dora
role_de: Arbeitseinsatzführer für die Zuweisung der Häftlingsarbeit im KZ Mittelbau-Dora
role_ru: руководитель распределения труда заключённых в Миттельбау-Дора
role_fr: responsable de l’affectation au travail des détenus à Mittelbau-Dora
status_en: Sentenced on 30 December 1947 to life imprisonment; released early in 1954.
interpretation_en: The profile links Simon’s responsibility to his documented role in the forced-labour system and his own admission of beating prisoners, not to every crime at Mittelbau-Dora.
crime_profile_pl: Jako Arbeitseinsatzführer Mittelbau-Dora organizował przydział pracy więźniów i przyznał przed sądem, że bił więźniów oznaczonych jako homoseksualni. Skazany na dożywocie 30 grudnia 1947 r., został zwolniony przedterminowo w 1954 r.
postwar_en: Sentenced on 30 December 1947 to life imprisonment, he was released early in 1954 and died on 27 September 1971.
limitations_en: No victim total is assigned and his admission is not extended beyond its documented scope. No portrait with clearly documented publication rights was found.

name: Wilhelm Ritter von Leeb
organization_en: Wehrmacht; Army Group North
role_en: field marshal and commander of Army Group North
role_pl: feldmarszałek i dowódca Grupy Armii Północ
role_de: Generalfeldmarschall und Oberbefehlshaber der Heeresgruppe Nord
role_ru: генерал-фельдмаршал и командующий группой армий «Север»
role_fr: maréchal et commandant du groupe d’armées Nord
region_en: northern sector of the war against the Soviet Union
status_en: Sentenced in 1948 to 3 years; pre-trial detention was credited as time served.
interpretation_en: The profile attributes only the responsibility fixed by the judgment: passing the Barbarossa Jurisdiction Order down the chain of command and bearing a measure of responsibility for its illegal application by subordinate units; it does not claim that he personally carried out the order.
crime_profile_pl: Jako dowódca Grupy Armii Północ wprowadził rozkaz o jurysdykcji Barbarossa do łańcucha dowodzenia. Sąd ustalił, że podległe mu jednostki stosowały go w sposób zbrodniczy i że ponosił część odpowiedzialności za to bezprawne stosowanie.
postwar_en: After credit for detention, the sentence was deemed served; von Leeb was released on 29 October 1948 and died in 1956.
limitations_en: The profile does not attribute Einsatzgruppen crimes or charges on which he was acquitted. No portrait with clearly documented publication rights was found.

name: Wolfgang Seuss
organization_en: SS; Dachau and Natzweiler concentration camps
role_en: SS functionary in supervisory posts at Dachau and head of the prisoners’ camp at Natzweiler
role_pl: funkcjonariusz nadzorczy SS w KL Dachau i kierownik obozu więźniarskiego w KL Natzweiler
role_de: SS-Funktionär in Aufsichtsfunktionen in Dachau und Leiter des Häftlingslagers in Natzweiler
role_ru: сотрудник СС на надзорных должностях в Дахау и начальник лагеря заключённых в Нацвейлере
role_fr: cadre SS chargé de la surveillance à Dachau et chef du camp des détenus à Natzweiler
status_en: Sentenced to life imprisonment in 1960; released in 1970.
interpretation_en: The 1946 acquittal concerned 1 narrowly defined charge and must not be presented as an acquittal for the acts adjudicated later.
crime_profile_pl: Pełnił funkcje nadzorcze w Dachau i Natzweiler. Źródła dokumentują jego rozkazy wobec Germaina Lutza, a sąd monachijski skazał go za zabójstwo dwóch żydowskich więźniów.
postwar_en: The French death sentence was commuted; Seuss was pardoned in 1959. After the West German life sentence, he was released in 1970 and died in 1979.
limitations_en: The profile keeps the accusations and outcomes of the separate proceedings distinct and gives no aggregate victim total. The cited sources confirm only the years of birth and death (1907–1979), not the exact dates or places. No portrait with clearly documented publication rights was found.

name: Albert Lütkemeyer
organization_en: SS; Neuengamme concentration camp; Riese camp complex
role_en: first Schutzhaftlagerführer at Neuengamme
role_pl: pierwszy Schutzhaftlagerführer w KL Neuengamme
role_de: erster Schutzhaftlagerführer im KZ Neuengamme
role_ru: первый шуцхафтлагерфюрер Нойенгамме
role_fr: premier Schutzhaftlagerführer à Neuengamme
status_en: Sentenced to death and executed on 26 June 1947.
interpretation_en: The profile combines his command responsibility with a specific admitted act but does not automatically attribute every crime of the camps where he served.
crime_profile_pl: Jako pierwszy Schutzhaftlagerführer współkierował terrorem w Neuengamme. W oświadczeniu z 1946 r. przyznał, że podczas egzekucji grupy 59 sowieckich oficerów osobiście zastrzelił pięciu.
postwar_en: Following the British military court’s judgment, he was executed at Hameln on 26 June 1947.
limitations_en: The figures 59 and 5 refer only to 1 documented execution and his own statement, not to an aggregate victim count. No portrait with clearly documented publication rights was found.

name: Albert Hugo Schuster
organization_en: Order Police; Motorized Gendarmerie Platoon 62
role_en: commander of Motorized Gendarmerie Platoon 62
role_pl: dowódca 62. zmotoryzowanego plutonu żandarmerii
role_de: Kommandeur des motorisierten Gendarmerie-Zuges 62
role_ru: командир моторизованного взвода жандармерии 62
role_fr: commandant du peloton motorisé de gendarmerie 62
status_en: Executed in 1973; in 1994 the sentence was posthumously reduced to life imprisonment.
interpretation_en: The profile attributes the documented command and actions of his platoon to Schuster but does not combine conflicting victim figures from studies with different scopes.
crime_profile_pl: Dowodził 62. zmotoryzowanym plutonem żandarmerii, którego udokumentowane działania na Kielecczyźnie obejmowały egzekucje i terror wobec ludności cywilnej.
postwar_en: The East German Supreme Court upheld the judgment; in 1994 a Chemnitz court posthumously changed the sentence to life imprisonment.
limitations_en: The posthumous 1994 decision concerned the punishment and is not presented as a historical exoneration. No portrait with clearly documented publication rights was found.

name: Benno Orendi
organization_en: SS; Ravensbrück and Stutthof concentration camps
role_en: SS camp doctor at Ravensbrück and Stutthof
role_pl: lekarz obozowy SS w KL Ravensbrück i KL Stutthof
role_de: SS-Lagerarzt in Ravensbrück und Stutthof
role_ru: лагерный врач СС в Равенсбрюке и Штуттгофе
role_fr: médecin SS des camps de Ravensbrück et de Stutthof
status_en: Sentenced to death in the fourth Ravensbrück trial and executed on 17 September 1948.
interpretation_en: The profile attributes his participation in selections as found by the court and his documented medical posts, without extending responsibility to every act by the medical staff of both camps.
crime_profile_pl: Pełnił funkcję lekarza obozowego SS w Ravensbrück i Stutthofie; brytyjski trybunał wojskowy skazał go za udział w selekcjach więźniarek.
postwar_en: A British military court sentenced him to death for participating in selections; he was executed at Hameln on 17 September 1948.
limitations_en: The account is limited to the cited findings; it gives no victim total and attributes no experiments without separate evidence. No portrait with clearly documented publication rights was found.

name: Engelbert Valentin Niedermeyer
organization_en: SS; Dachau concentration camp
role_en: block leader and supervisor of a work detail at the Dachau crematorium
role_pl: blokowy i nadzorca komanda przy krematorium KL Dachau
role_de: Blockführer und Aufseher eines Arbeitskommandos am Dachauer Krematorium
role_ru: блокфюрер и надзиратель рабочей команды при крематории Дахау
role_fr: chef de block et surveillant d’un commando de travail au crématoire de Dachau
status_en: Convicted in the main Dachau trial and executed on 28 May 1946.
interpretation_en: The profile links his supervisory posts with the violence he admitted and the judicial outcome, but does not attribute every act of the crematorium detail or the camp’s entire operation to him.
crime_profile_pl: Jako blokowy i nadzorca komanda przy krematorium KL Dachau sprawował władzę nad więźniami; w zeznaniach przyznał, że ich bił.
postwar_en: A US military court sentenced him to death in the main Dachau trial; he was executed at Landsberg on 28 May 1946.
limitations_en: The sources differ on his final SS rank, so the rank field uses a general description. No victim total is assigned. No portrait with clearly documented publication rights was found.

name: Friedrich Boßhammer
organization_en: RSHA IV B 4; BdS Italy
role_en: RSHA IV B 4 official and Jewish-affairs officer with the BdS in Italy
role_pl: referent IV B 4 RSHA i pełnomocnik do spraw żydowskich przy BdS we Włoszech
role_de: Mitarbeiter des RSHA-Referats IV B 4 und Judenreferent beim BdS in Italien
role_ru: сотрудник отдела IV B 4 РСХА и референт по еврейским делам при BdS в Италии
role_fr: fonctionnaire du RSHA IV B 4 et responsable des affaires juives auprès du BdS en Italie
status_en: Given a non-final life sentence in 1972; died during the appeal.
interpretation_en: The profile records his documented administrative and organisational role in the deportations without attributing personal commission of every crime connected with the transports.
crime_profile_pl: Jako referent IV B 4 i pełnomocnik do spraw żydowskich przy BdS we Włoszech uczestniczył w organizowaniu transportów deportacyjnych Żydów z Włoch do obozów koncentracyjnych i zagłady.
postwar_en: Boßhammer died on 17 December 1972 while the appeal was pending; the judgment did not become final.
limitations_en: The profile preserves the procedural distinction between the judgment and its finality and gives no independent victim total. No portrait with clearly documented publication rights was found.

name: Heinrich Andergassen
organization_en: Gestapo; SD; Sipo Bolzano
role_en: head of the SD outpost in Merano and Sipo officer in Bolzano
role_pl: kierownik placówki SD w Merano i funkcjonariusz Sipo w Bolzano
role_de: Leiter der SD-Außenstelle Meran und Sipo-Funktionär in Bozen
role_ru: начальник отделения СД в Мерано и сотрудник зипо в Больцано
role_fr: chef de l’antenne du SD à Merano et fonctionnaire de la Sipo à Bolzano
status_en: Sentenced to death by a US military commission and executed on 26 July 1946.
interpretation_en: The profile attributes only the documented deportation order and specific murders and torture, not all actions of the structures in which he served.
crime_profile_pl: Jako funkcjonariusz Gestapo i SD w Tyrolu Południowym zarządził deportację Żydów z Merano, zabił Manlia Longona oraz uczestniczył w torturach i zabójstwie Rodericka Halla.
postwar_en: He was tried in Naples from 9 to 15 January 1946; after the death sentence he was executed on 26 July 1946.
limitations_en: Sources variously place the execution near Pisa or Livorno; the execution date is secure. Institutional sources date Longon’s death to either 31 December 1944 or 1 January 1945; the profile therefore describes it as occurring during the night spanning those dates. No portrait with clearly documented publication rights was found.

name: Heinrich Eisenhöfer
organization_en: SS; Mauthausen concentration camp
role_en: head of prisoner-property administration at Mauthausen
role_pl: kierownik administracji mienia więźniów w KL Mauthausen
role_de: Leiter der Häftlingseigentumsverwaltung im KZ Mauthausen
role_ru: начальник управления имуществом заключённых в Маутхаузене
role_fr: chef de l’administration des biens des détenus à Mauthausen
status_en: Sentenced to death and executed in late May 1947.
interpretation_en: The profile links his administrative post to his specific admitted participation in executions without attributing every crime of the camp to him.
crime_profile_pl: Kierował administracją mienia więźniów w Mauthausen. W oświadczeniu przedstawionym w procesie przyznał, że w latach 1943–1944 uczestniczył na rozkaz w dwóch egzekucjach.
postwar_en: After review of the judgment, he was executed at Landsberg am Lech in late May 1947.
limitations_en: The figure 2 refers only to the executions admitted in his own statement, not to a complete victim total. No portrait with clearly documented publication rights was found.

name: Heinrich Josten
organization_en: SS; Auschwitz concentration camp
role_en: SS officer responsible for the camp detention block and a guard company at Auschwitz
role_pl: oficer SS przy areszcie obozowym i kompanii wartowniczej KL Auschwitz
role_de: SS-Offizier beim Lagerarrest und bei einer Wachkompanie in Auschwitz
role_ru: офицер СС, отвечавший за лагерную тюрьму и охранную роту в Аушвице
role_fr: officier SS responsable de la prison du camp et d’une compagnie de garde à Auschwitz
status_en: Convicted in the Kraków Auschwitz trial and executed on 24 January 1948.
interpretation_en: The profile attributes only the functions and individual acts identified in the trial material, not every crime by the guard company or the Auschwitz complex.
crime_profile_pl: Pełnił w Auschwitz funkcje kierownicze przy areszcie obozowym i kompanii wartowniczej; sąd ustalił jego udział w selekcjach, egzekucjach przy bloku 11 oraz przemocy wobec więźniów.
postwar_en: Poland’s Supreme National Tribunal sentenced him to death; after clemency was refused, he was executed at Kraków on 24 January 1948.
limitations_en: No separate victim total is assigned, and the court’s findings are not extended to events absent from the cited sources. No portrait with clearly documented publication rights was found.

name: Hermann Helbig
organization_en: SS; Buchenwald concentration camp
role_en: leader of the crematorium detail and member of Kommando 99 at Buchenwald
role_pl: kierownik komanda krematorium i członek Kommando 99 w KL Buchenwald
role_de: Kommandoführer im Krematorium und Mitglied des Kommandos 99 in Buchenwald
role_ru: руководитель команды крематория и участник команды 99 в Бухенвальде
role_fr: chef du commando du crématoire et membre du Kommando 99 à Buchenwald
status_en: Convicted in the main Buchenwald trial and executed on 19 November 1948.
interpretation_en: Membership in Kommando 99 and his crematorium post are recorded as documented forms of participation; the profile does not assign him the independent decision for every execution or all victims of that unit.
crime_profile_pl: Kierował komandem krematorium w Buchenwaldzie i należał do Kommando 99, które mordowało sowieckich jeńców wojennych; później dowodził podobozem Wansleben.
postwar_en: A US military court sentenced him to death in the main Buchenwald trial; he was executed at Landsberg on 19 November 1948.
limitations_en: No individual victim total is assigned to Helbig, and his personal participation is limited to the cited findings. No portrait with clearly documented publication rights was found.

name: Josef Jarolin
organization_en: SS; Dachau concentration camp and Allach subcamp
role_en: report leader and third protective-custody camp leader at Dachau, later commandant of Allach
role_pl: Rapportführer i trzeci Schutzhaftlagerführer w Dachau, następnie kierownik podobozu Allach
role_de: Rapportführer und dritter Schutzhaftlagerführer in Dachau, später Lagerführer von Allach
role_ru: раппортфюрер и третий руководитель лагеря превентивного заключения в Дахау, затем начальник Аллаха
role_fr: chef des appels et troisième responsable du camp de détention préventive à Dachau, puis chef d’Allach
status_en: Sentenced to death on 13 December 1945 and executed on 28 May 1946.
interpretation_en: The profile grounds attribution in his admission and the trial record, not in rank alone; it does not assign him every execution or every act of violence at Dachau and Allach.
crime_profile_pl: Pełnił funkcje kierownicze w Dachau i Allach; przyznał wydawanie rozkazów strzelania oraz udział w zamordowaniu 1500 sowieckich jeńców wojennych w Hebertshausen.
postwar_en: A US military court sentenced him to death on 13 December 1945; he was executed at Landsberg on 28 May 1946.
limitations_en: The figure of 1500 refers only to his admitted participation in the Hebertshausen execution and is not presented as a complete victim total for Jarolin. No portrait with clearly documented publication rights was found.

name: Josef Niedermayer
organization_en: SS; Mauthausen concentration camp
role_en: head of the camp prison and block leader of Block 20 at Mauthausen
role_pl: kierownik więzienia obozowego i blokowy bloku 20 w KL Mauthausen
role_de: Leiter des Lagergefängnisses und Blockführer von Block 20 in Mauthausen
role_ru: начальник лагерной тюрьмы и блокфюрер блока 20 в Маутхаузене
role_fr: chef de la prison du camp et responsable du block 20 à Mauthausen
status_en: Sentenced to death on 13 May 1946 and executed on 28 May 1947.
interpretation_en: The profile separates his admission and the acts described by the sources from the wider responsibility of the Mauthausen apparatus; the figure of about 400 is not treated as a complete victim total.
crime_profile_pl: Kierował więzieniem obozowym w Mauthausen i blokiem 20; przyznał udział z rozkazu w około 400 egzekucjach, a po ucieczce jeńców kierował pościgiem i uczestniczył w zabójstwach.
postwar_en: A US military court sentenced him to death on 13 May 1946; he was executed at Landsberg on 28 May 1947.
limitations_en: The account does not total all victims of Block 20 or the pursuit after the escape and does not convert collective responsibility into unsupported individual acts. No portrait with clearly documented publication rights was found.

name: Josef Remmele
organization_en: SS; Dachau and Auschwitz concentration camps
role_en: roll-call leader at Dachau and commandant of the Eintrachthütte and Jawischowitz subcamps
role_pl: Rapportführer w Dachau i kierownik podobozów Auschwitz Eintrachthütte oraz Jawischowitz
role_de: Rapportführer in Dachau und Leiter der Außenlager Eintrachthütte und Jawischowitz
role_ru: раппортфюрер в Дахау и начальник подлагерей Айнтрахтхютте и Явишовиц
role_fr: chef des appels à Dachau et chef des sous-camps d’Eintrachthütte et de Jawischowitz
status_en: Sentenced to death in September 1947 and executed at Landsberg in 1948.
interpretation_en: The profile distinguishes Remmele’s proven acts at Dachau from conditions in the Auschwitz subcamps; it does not attribute selections conducted by doctors or every abuse by subordinate guards to him.
crime_profile_pl: Pełnił funkcje kierownicze w Dachau oraz w podobozach Auschwitz; w procesie przyznał wydanie rozkazów ognia podczas dwóch egzekucji, w których zabito 40 i 97 Rosjan.
postwar_en: A US military court sentenced him to death in September 1947; he was executed at Landsberg in 1948.
limitations_en: Exact attribution is limited to his admitted orders and the court’s findings; the subcamp account documents his office and context, not every individual crime. No portrait with clearly documented publication rights was found.

name: Josef Seuss
organization_en: SS; Dachau concentration camp; Radolfzell subcamp
role_en: work-detail commander and senior functionary in the Dachau camp system
role_pl: SS-Hauptscharführer, dowódca komand pracy i funkcjonariusz kierowniczy systemu KL Dachau
role_de: Kommandoführer eines Arbeitskommandos und leitender Funktionär im Dachauer Lagersystem
role_ru: командир рабочей команды и руководящий функционер системы Дахау
role_fr: chef de commando de travail et cadre du système concentrationnaire de Dachau
status_en: Found guilty on 13 December 1945 and executed on 28 May 1946.
interpretation_en: The profile attributes only Seuss’s documented function, his own admission and individualising testimony, together with the responsibility established by the judgment.
crime_profile_pl: Jako dowódca komanda pracy w Radolfzell stosował udokumentowaną przemoc wobec więźniów, do części której sam się przyznał. W głównym procesie załogi Dachau został skazany na śmierć 13 grudnia 1945 r. i stracony 28 maja 1946 r.
postwar_en: After the guilty finding of 13 December 1945, the death sentence was affirmed and carried out at Landsberg on 28 May 1946.
limitations_en: Witness accounts are identified as testimony, and not every act of the Dachau staff or other subcamps is assigned to Seuss. No portrait with clearly documented publication rights was found.

name: Max Schobert
organization_en: SS; Buchenwald concentration camp
rank: SS-Sturmbannführer według akt procesu; źródło muzealne podaje SS-Hauptscharführer
role_en: Schutzhaftlagerführer at Buchenwald
role_pl: Schutzhaftlagerführer KL Buchenwald
role_de: Schutzhaftlagerführer in Buchenwald
role_ru: шуцхафтлагерфюрер Бухенвальда
role_fr: Schutzhaftlagerführer à Buchenwald
status_en: Sentenced to death on 14 August 1947 and executed on 19 November 1948.
interpretation_en: The profile links his documented post as Schutzhaftlagerführer to an individual survivor’s account of his threatening speech, without assigning every crime committed at Buchenwald to him.
crime_profile_pl: Schutzhaftlagerführer w Buchenwaldzie w latach 1940–1945. Ocalały Gert Schramm wspominał, że gdy jego transport przybył w lipcu 1944 r., Schobert przywitał go przemową pełną gróźb. Skazany na śmierć 14 sierpnia 1947 r., został stracony 19 listopada 1948 r.
postwar_en: The death sentence of 14 August 1947 was affirmed and carried out at Landsberg on 19 November 1948.
limitations_en: The sources differ over the stated SS rank, so the discrepancy is made explicit; no separate victim total is assigned. No portrait with clearly documented publication rights was found.

name: Michael Redwitz
organization_en: SS; Dachau concentration camp
role_en: Schutzhaftlagerführer responsible for discipline and camp punishments at Dachau
role_pl: Schutzhaftlagerführer KL Dachau odpowiedzialny za dyscyplinę i kary obozowe
role_de: Schutzhaftlagerführer mit Verantwortung für Disziplin und Lagerstrafen in Dachau
role_ru: шуцхафтлагерфюрер, отвечавший за дисциплину и лагерные наказания в Дахау
role_fr: Schutzhaftlagerführer responsable de la discipline et des sanctions du camp à Dachau
status_en: Sentenced to death on 13 December 1945; executed on 29 May 1946.
interpretation_en: The profile attributes documented command of the disciplinary apparatus and official participation in executions and camp punishments to Redwitz, without extending responsibility beyond the court findings and cited evidence.
crime_profile_pl: Jako Schutzhaftlagerführer KL Dachau odpowiadał za dyscyplinę i kary wobec więźniów oraz uczestniczył służbowo w egzekucjach i wymierzaniu kar obozowych. Amerykański trybunał skazał go w 1945 r. na śmierć; został stracony w 1946 r.
postwar_en: After the war he faced a US military court in the Dachau main camp trial; the death sentence was carried out at Landsberg prison on 29 May 1946.
limitations_en: No individual victim total is assigned to Redwitz, and no decision concerning a particular execution is attributed to him without an explicit source finding. No portrait with clearly documented publication rights was found.

name: Otto Lätsch
organization_en: SS; Auschwitz concentration camp, Gleiwitz IV subcamp
organization_pl: SS; KL Auschwitz, podobóz Gleiwitz IV
role_en: Lagerführer of the Auschwitz subcamp Gleiwitz IV
role_pl: Lagerführer podobozu Auschwitz Gleiwitz IV
role_de: Lagerführer des Auschwitz-Außenlagers Gleiwitz IV
role_ru: лагерфюрер подлагеря Аушвиц Гляйвиц IV
role_fr: Lagerführer du camp annexe Gleiwitz IV d’Auschwitz
status_en: Sentenced to death on 22 December 1947; executed on 24 January 1948.
interpretation_en: The profile records Lätsch’s command decisions, selections for extermination and direct violence established by the judgment, without automatically assigning every crime committed at Gleiwitz IV to him.
crime_profile_pl: Jako Lagerführer podobozu Auschwitz Gleiwitz IV kierował selekcjami więźniów do komór gazowych, znęcał się nad więźniami i odpowiadał za zbrodnie podczas likwidacji obozu. Najwyższy Trybunał Narodowy skazał go w 1947 r. na śmierć; został stracony w 1948 r.
postwar_en: The Supreme National Tribunal sentenced him to death on 22 December 1947; the sentence was carried out in Kraków on 24 January 1948.
limitations_en: The judicial source and the Auschwitz Museum differ on the number of people who survived the infirmary fire; the profile gives no such number. No portrait with clearly documented publication rights was found.

name: Otto Stadie
tier_label_fr: Rouages de la guerre et de l’occupation
organization_en: SS; Treblinka extermination camp
role_en: Stabsscharführer and administrative head of personnel at Treblinka
role_pl: Stabsscharführer i kierownik administracyjny personelu w ośrodku zagłady Treblinka
role_de: Stabsscharführer und Verwaltungsleiter des Personals in Treblinka
role_ru: штабсшарфюрер и административный руководитель персонала Треблинки
role_fr: Stabsscharführer et responsable administratif du personnel à Treblinka
status_en: Sentenced on 3 September 1965 to 7 years in prison; the judgment was upheld on 30 June 1970.
interpretation_en: The profile describes Stadie as an organizational link in the extermination process and a perpetrator of documented violence, in line with the individual findings of the judgment, not as the sole decision-maker for the entire Treblinka operation.
crime_profile_pl: Jako Stabsscharführer i kierownik administracyjny w Treblince organizował służbę wartowniczą, przyjmowanie transportów i działania umożliwiające masowe mordowanie deportowanych, a także osobiście stosował przemoc. Sąd w Düsseldorfie skazał go w 1965 r. na 7 lat więzienia; wyrok utrzymano w 1970 r.
postwar_en: The Düsseldorf trial imposed a 7-year prison term with pretrial detention credited; the decision became final after the ruling of 30 June 1970.
limitations_en: No individual victim total is assigned to Stadie, and his administrative and direct participation is distinguished from command of the whole camp. No portrait with clearly documented publication rights was found.

name: Paul Hermann Feustel
organization_en: Gestapo; Security Police and SD
role_en: head of Gestapo offices in Kolín and Benešov responsible for repression and executions
role_pl: kierownik placówek Gestapo w Kolínie i Benešovie odpowiedzialny za represje i egzekucje
role_de: Leiter der Gestapo-Dienststellen in Kolín und Benešov mit Verantwortung für Repressionen und Hinrichtungen
role_ru: руководитель отделений гестапо в Колине и Бенешове, отвечавший за репрессии и казни
role_fr: chef des bureaux de la Gestapo à Kolín et Benešov, responsable de la répression et des exécutions
status_en: Sentenced to death on 11 December 1972; executed on 8 May 1973.
interpretation_en: The profile attributes command of documented Gestapo operations and personal participation in execution actions to Feustel, limiting the account to conduct established in the files and historical research.
crime_profile_pl: Jako kierownik placówek Gestapo w Kolínie i Benešovie organizował represje wobec ludności czeskiej, w tym aresztowania, przesłuchania, deportacje i egzekucje. Sąd w Berlinie Wschodnim skazał go w 1972 r. na śmierć za zbrodnie wojenne i przeciw ludzkości; został stracony w 1973 r.
postwar_en: After years living under a false identity, he was tried; the judgment of 11 December 1972 was upheld on appeal on 26 January 1973 and carried out on 8 May 1973.
limitations_en: A museum article from 2011 gives 18 May as the execution date, while later file-based accounts and the accepted chronology give 8 May; the profile uses the latter date and discloses the discrepancy. No portrait with clearly documented publication rights was found.

name: Paul Szczurek
organization_en: SS; Auschwitz concentration camp
role_en: guard and Blockführer at Auschwitz who took part in selections and killings
role_pl: strażnik i Blockführer KL Auschwitz uczestniczący w selekcjach i zabójstwach więźniów
role_de: Wachmann und Blockführer in Auschwitz mit Beteiligung an Selektionen und Morden
role_ru: охранник и блокфюрер Аушвица, участвовавший в отборах и убийствах
role_fr: garde et Blockführer à Auschwitz ayant participé aux sélections et aux meurtres
status_en: Sentenced to death on 22 December 1947; executed on 24 January 1948.
interpretation_en: The profile attributes specific acts established by the judgment to Szczurek: selections, driving victims into the gas chambers, abuse and individual killings.
crime_profile_pl: Jako strażnik i Blockführer w Auschwitz uczestniczył w selekcjach do komór gazowych, prowadził ofiary do komór, maltretował więźniów i dokonywał indywidualnych zabójstw. Najwyższy Trybunał Narodowy skazał go w 1947 r. na śmierć; został stracony w 1948 r.
postwar_en: The Supreme National Tribunal sentenced him to death on 22 December 1947; the sentence was carried out in Kraków on 24 January 1948.
limitations_en: The profile does not derive a total victim count for Szczurek beyond the specific acts described in the judgment and does not equate his participation in the SS group handling selections and gassing with command of the entire extermination mechanism. No portrait with clearly documented publication rights was found.

name: Percival “Percy” Treite
organization_en: SS; Ravensbrück concentration camp medical service
role_en: SS camp doctor at Ravensbrück who performed forced abortions and sterilizations
role_pl: lekarz SS w KL Ravensbrück wykonujący przymusowe aborcje i sterylizacje
role_de: SS-Lagerarzt in Ravensbrück, der Zwangsabtreibungen und Zwangssterilisationen durchführte
role_ru: лагерный врач СС в Равенсбрюке, проводивший принудительные аборты и стерилизации
role_fr: médecin SS à Ravensbrück ayant pratiqué des avortements et des stérilisations forcés
status_en: Sentenced to death on 3 February 1947; died by suicide on 8 April 1947 before the sentence was carried out.
interpretation_en: The profile attributes Treite’s own forced procedures and documented medical responsibility to him, distinguishing them from experiments by other doctors that should not automatically be assigned to him.
crime_profile_pl: Jako lekarz SS w Ravensbrück przeprowadzał przymusowe aborcje i sterylizacje oraz uczestniczył w opiece nad kobietami poddawanymi zbrodniczym eksperymentom. Brytyjski trybunał skazał go w 1947 r. na śmierć; popełnił samobójstwo w więzieniu przed wykonaniem wyroku.
postwar_en: In the first Ravensbrück trial, a British military court sentenced him to death on 3 February 1947; Treite died by suicide on 8 April 1947, so the sentence was not carried out.
limitations_en: The sources distinguish Treite’s abortions and sterilizations and his treatment of women after experiments from the entire experimental programme conducted by other doctors; the profile preserves that distinction. No portrait with clearly documented publication rights was found.

name: Rolf Rosenthal
organization_en: SS; Ravensbrück concentration camp medical service
role_en: SS camp doctor at Ravensbrück involved in forced abortions and criminal procedures
role_pl: lekarz SS w KL Ravensbrück uczestniczący w przymusowych aborcjach i zbrodniczych zabiegach
role_de: SS-Lagerarzt in Ravensbrück mit Beteiligung an Zwangsabtreibungen und verbrecherischen Eingriffen
role_ru: лагерный врач СС в Равенсбрюке, участвовавший в принудительных абортах и преступных процедурах
role_fr: médecin SS à Ravensbrück impliqué dans des avortements forcés et des interventions criminelles
status_en: Sentenced to death on 3 February 1947; executed on 3 May 1947.
interpretation_en: The profile links Rosenthal only to conduct documented in his affidavit, witness evidence, the archival inventory and the judgment, without assigning the entire Ravensbrück experimental programme to him.
crime_profile_pl: Jako lekarz SS w Ravensbrück wykonywał przymusowe aborcje, uczestniczył w zbrodniczych zabiegach na więźniarkach i był wskazywany w dokumentacji dotyczącej śmiertelnych zastrzyków. Brytyjski trybunał skazał go w 1947 r. na śmierć; został stracony w tym samym roku.
postwar_en: A British military court sentenced him to death on 3 February 1947; the sentence was carried out by hanging in Hamelin on 3 May 1947.
limitations_en: The record supports forced abortions, participation in procedures and references to lethal injections, but does not justify attributing every experiment or the full victim total to Rosenthal. No portrait with clearly documented publication rights was found.

name: Waldemar Wolter
organization_en: SS; Mauthausen concentration camp
role_en: chief SS physician at Mauthausen concentration camp
role_pl: naczelny lekarz SS w KL Mauthausen
role_de: leitender SS-Arzt im KZ Mauthausen
role_ru: главный врач СС в концлагере Маутхаузен
role_fr: médecin-chef SS au camp de concentration de Mauthausen
status_en: Sentenced to death in the Mauthausen main trial and executed on 28 May 1947.
interpretation_en: The profile attributes to Wolter participation in selections and the responsibility established by the court, without automatically transferring to him every crime committed by the Mauthausen medical staff.
crime_profile_pl: Jako naczelny lekarz SS w Mauthausen uczestniczył w selekcjach chorych więźniów kierowanych do komory gazowej; powojenne zeznania wiązały go z przekazywaniem chorych do zagłady. Skazany na śmierć w głównym procesie Mauthausen i stracony 28 maja 1947 r.
postwar_en: The Mauthausen main trial sentenced him to death in 1947, and he was executed on 28 May 1947.
limitations_en: The sources also contain defence-favourable testimony and differing assessments of the extent of his conduct, so the profile sets no separate victim total. No portrait with clearly documented publication rights was found.

name: Werner Alfred Berger
tier_label_fr: Rouages de la guerre et de l’occupation
organization_en: SS; Buchenwald concentration camp
role_en: member of the execution unit Kommando 99 at Buchenwald
role_pl: esesman z Kommando 99 wykonującego egzekucje w KL Buchenwald
role_de: Mitglied des Hinrichtungskommandos 99 im KZ Buchenwald
role_ru: член расстрельной команды 99 в концлагере Бухенвальд
role_fr: membre de l’unité d’exécution Kommando 99 à Buchenwald
status_en: Sentenced to life imprisonment in 1947 and died in 1964; the cited sources do not establish the later course of his sentence.
interpretation_en: The profile attributes Berger’s own shooting actions and participation in the execution unit to him, not the unit’s entire number of killings.
crime_profile_pl: Jako esesman Kommando 99 w Buchenwaldzie brał udział w egzekucjach więźniów i jeńców; w procesie zeznał, że około 15 razy sam strzelał przez szczelinę w ścianie pomieszczenia egzekucyjnego. W 1947 r. skazano go na dożywotnie więzienie; zmarł w 1964 r.
postwar_en: He was sentenced to life imprisonment in 1947. He died in 1964; the cited sources do not document the date or basis of any later release.
limitations_en: The approximately 800 people killed in the charge referred to the Kommando’s activity during the charged period, not to Berger’s personal victim total. The cited sources do not establish the later course of his sentence. No approved portrait for publication was found.

name: Wilhelm Bahr
tier_label_fr: Rouages de la guerre et de l’occupation
organization_en: SS; Neuengamme concentration camp
role_en: SS medical orderly at Neuengamme and direct participant in killing prisoners with gas
role_pl: sanitariusz SS w KL Neuengamme, uczestnik zabójstwa jeńców radzieckich gazem
role_de: SS-Sanitäter im KZ Neuengamme und unmittelbarer Beteiligter an der Tötung von Gefangenen durch Gas
role_ru: санитар СС в Нойенгамме и непосредственный участник убийства заключённых газом
role_fr: infirmier SS à Neuengamme et participant direct au meurtre de prisonniers par gaz
status_en: Sentenced to death in the first Neuengamme trial in 1946 and executed on 8 October 1946.
interpretation_en: The profile attributes to Bahr the direct initiation of the gassing, as confirmed by trial and memorial records, not general responsibility for every killing at Neuengamme.
crime_profile_pl: Jako sanitariusz SS w Neuengamme wpuścił Cyklon B do zamkniętej celi i uczestniczył w zabójstwie 197 radzieckich jeńców wojennych; w zeznaniu procesowym podał zaokrągloną liczbę 200. Skazany na śmierć w pierwszym procesie Neuengamme i stracony 8 października 1946 r.
postwar_en: A British tribunal sentenced him to death in 1946, and the sentence was carried out on 8 October 1946.
limitations_en: The memorial gives 197 victims, while the record quotes Bahr’s testimony referring to 200 prisoners; the profile preserves that discrepancy rather than creating a falsely uniform figure. No approved portrait for publication was found.

name: Wilhelm Dreimann
tier_label_fr: Rouages de la guerre et de l’occupation
organization_en: SS; Neuengamme concentration camp
role_en: SS Rapportführer at Neuengamme and participant in the Bullenhuser Damm murders
role_pl: Rapportführer SS w KL Neuengamme i uczestnik mordu przy Bullenhuser Damm
role_de: SS-Rapportführer in Neuengamme und Beteiligter an den Morden am Bullenhuser Damm
role_ru: раппортфюрер СС в Нойенгамме и участник убийств на Булленхузер-Дамм
role_fr: Rapportführer SS à Neuengamme et participant aux meurtres de Bullenhuser Damm
status_en: Sentenced to death in the first Neuengamme trial in 1946 and executed on 8 October 1946.
interpretation_en: The profile attributes the documented transport of victims and participation in executions to Dreimann, while separately marking that the detail concerning the children comes from a co-perpetrator’s testimony.
crime_profile_pl: Jako Rapportführer w Neuengamme uczestniczył w przewiezieniu 20 żydowskich dzieci i 4 opiekunów na miejsce mordu przy Bullenhuser Damm oraz w wieszaniu dorosłych; według współsprawcy uczestniczył też w zabiciu pierwszych 2 dzieci. Skazany na śmierć i stracony 8 października 1946 r.
postwar_en: A British tribunal sentenced him to death in 1946, and the sentence was carried out on 8 October 1946.
limitations_en: Attribution of participation in hanging the first 2 children rests especially on co-perpetrator Johann Frahm’s testimony; Dreimann denied involvement. No approved portrait for publication was found.

name: Wilhelm Gerhard Gehring
organization_en: SS; Auschwitz, Monowitz and Eintrachthütte camps
organization_pl: SS; KL Auschwitz, Monowitz i Eintrachthütte
role_en: Blockführer and detention supervisor at Auschwitz who participated in executions
role_pl: esesman kierujący blokiem i aresztem w Auschwitz, uczestnik egzekucji
role_de: Blockführer und Arrestaufseher in Auschwitz, beteiligt an Hinrichtungen
role_ru: блокфюрер и надзиратель ареста в Аушвице, участник казней
role_fr: Blockführer et surveillant du bloc d’arrêt à Auschwitz ayant participé à des exécutions
status_en: Sentenced to death by the Supreme National Tribunal in 1947 and executed on 24 January 1948.
interpretation_en: The profile bases Gehring’s responsibility on individualized findings in the judgment and memorial documentation, not solely on the camp positions he held.
crime_profile_pl: Jako nadzorca aresztu i Blockführer w Auschwitz uczestniczył w indywidualnych i zbiorowych rozstrzeliwaniach przy Bloku 11 oraz w publicznych egzekucjach w Monowitz; później był kierownikiem podobozu Eintrachthütte. Najwyższy Trybunał Narodowy skazał go na śmierć, a wyrok wykonano 24 stycznia 1948 r.
postwar_en: The Supreme National Tribunal sentenced him to death on 22 December 1947, and the sentence was carried out on 24 January 1948.
limitations_en: The profile sets no separate victim total because the judgment describes numerous acts but does not provide a sound basis for one personal tally. No approved portrait for publication was found.

name: Wilhelm Schäfer
organization_en: SS; Lichtenburg concentration camp; Buchenwald concentration camp; Kommando 99; 20th Waffen Grenadier Division of the SS
organization_pl: SS; KL Lichtenburg; KL Buchenwald; Kommando 99; 20 Dywizja Grenadierów SS
role_en: SS-Hauptscharführer and member of Kommando 99 at Buchenwald
role_pl: SS-Hauptscharführer, członek Kommando 99 w KL Buchenwald
role_de: SS-Hauptscharführer und Angehöriger des Kommandos 99 im KZ Buchenwald
role_ru: гауптшарфюрер СС и участник команды 99 в Бухенвальде
role_fr: SS-Hauptscharführer et membre du commando 99 à Buchenwald
status_en: Sentenced to death by the Supreme Court of the GDR on 20 May 1961; executed on 16 June 1961.
interpretation_en: Schäfer’s responsibility rests on his documented membership in a specialised execution unit and on judicial findings about specific forms of violence, not merely on SS membership.
crime_profile_pl: Jako członek obozowego Kommando 99 uczestniczył w masowych rozstrzeliwaniach sowieckich jeńców w KL Buchenwald; sąd przypisał mu także przemoc wobec więźniów i udział w akcjach antypartyzanckich w Estonii. W 1961 r. został skazany na śmierć i stracony.
postwar_en: After a former Buchenwald prisoner recognised him, the Supreme Court of the GDR tried and sentenced him to death; he was executed in Leipzig on 16 June 1961.
limitations_en: The range from 700 to 1000 describes executions in which the court found that he participated, not a number killed by him alone. No portrait with clearly documented publication rights was found.

name: Wilhelm Wagner
organization_en: SS; Dachau concentration camp; Allach, Riederloh and Landsberg subcamps
organization_pl: SS; KL Dachau; podobozy Allach, Riederloh i Landsberg
role_en: SS-Hauptscharführer, prisoner work-detail leader and commandant of the Landsberg subcamp
role_pl: SS-Hauptscharführer, kierownik komand pracy więźniów i komendant podobozu Landsberg
role_de: SS-Hauptscharführer, Kommandoführer von Häftlingsarbeitskommandos und Lagerführer in Landsberg

status_en: Sentenced to death by hanging on 13 December 1945; executed on 29 May 1946.

crime_profile_pl: Kierował więźniarską pralnią w KL Dachau, gdzie wielokrotnie bił podległych mu więźniów, a później dowodził podobozami, w tym Landsberg. W głównym procesie załogi Dachau został skazany na śmierć i stracony 29 maja 1946 r.
postwar_en: The US military court in the main Dachau trial found him guilty of both charges and sentenced him to death; clemency was denied and the sentence was carried out on 29 May 1946.
limitations_en: The profile does not attribute every crime in the subcamps he led to Wagner; it is limited to documented acts of violence and the trial findings. No portrait with clearly documented publication rights was found.

name: Willi Mentz
organization_en: SS; Treblinka II extermination camp; Operation Reinhard
organization_pl: SS; obóz zagłady Treblinka II; Akcja „Reinhardt”

role_fr: SS-Unterscharführer et tireur de la fausse infirmerie de Treblinka II
status_en: Sentenced to life imprisonment on 3 September 1965; appeals dismissed on 30 June 1970; released for health reasons on 31 March 1978.
interpretation_en: Mentz’s responsibility is grounded in his personal and repeated performance of executions at the sham infirmary and in the precise scope of the final judgment, not in assigning every Treblinka victim to him.
crime_profile_pl: W pozornym lazarecie Treblinki II strzelał w tył głowy do osób chorych, starszych, z niepełnosprawnościami i dzieci oddzielonych od transportów. W 1965 r., przy częściowym uniewinnieniu, skazano go na dożywocie za pomocnictwo w masowym mordzie oraz w mordzie co najmniej 25 osób; zwolniono go ze względów zdrowotnych w 1978 r.
postwar_en: The 1965 life sentence remained in force after the appeals were dismissed in 1970. Mentz was released for health reasons on 31 March 1978 and died on 25 June 1978.
limitations_en: The judgment distinguished Mentz’s personal shootings from aiding the mass murder and included a partial acquittal; the profile preserves those legal distinctions and does not attribute Treblinka’s total victim count to him. The verified sources establish the date but not the exact place of death. No portrait with clearly documented publication rights was found.

status_en: Sentenced to death by hanging on 13 December 1945; executed on 29 May 1946.
interpretation_en: Kramer’s responsibility covers both command of a transport in lethal conditions and his personal violence at Kaufering I; the profile does not automatically transfer every crime of the entire Kaufering complex to him.
crime_profile_pl: Dowodził transportem około 4000 więźniów z KL Warschau do Dachau, podczas którego ludzie cierpieli z powodu braku wody, żywności, przemocy i śmierci, a następnie kierował podobozem Kaufering I, gdzie bił więźniów, czasem ze skutkiem śmiertelnym. W głównym procesie Dachau został skazany na śmierć i stracony 29 maja 1946 r.
postwar_en: The main Dachau trial found him guilty of both charges and sentenced him to death on 13 December 1945. The review recommendation found no basis for clemency; Kramer was hanged on 29 May 1946.
limitations_en: Kramer’s own statement accepted command responsibility for the transport and described its conditions but sought to shift part of the blame to superiors and guards; the profile separates those admissions from testimony about his personal beatings. No portrait with clearly documented publication rights was found.

postwar_en: A US military court sentenced him to death on 13 May 1946; after review, the sentence was upheld and carried out on 28 May 1947.
limitations_en: The Mauthausen Memorial yearbook published in 2016 cites an archival curriculum vitae with the date 28 November 1920, while a later table from 2024 gives 23 November; the profile uses 28 November, following the personnel-file description, and discloses the discrepancy. No portrait with clearly documented publication rights was found.

Skazany na śmierć w głównym procesie Dachau i stracony 28 maja 1946 r.
postwar_en: A United States court found him guilty on 12 December 1945; after the death sentence he was executed on 28 May 1946.
limitations_en: The account of specific acts comes from witness testimony reproduced in trial records and trial scholarship; the profile does not repeat unverified allegations about other camps or set a separate victim total. No approved portrait for publication was found.

status_en: Sentenced to death by hanging on 13 December 1945; executed on 29 May 1946.

crime_profile_pl: Jako komendant podobozów Kaufering II i VII bił więźniów; jednego z nich, próbującego pozostać z ojcem podczas selekcji, pobił do nieprzytomności, a podczas likwidacji obozu strzelał w grupę szukającą żywności. W głównym procesie Dachau został skazany na śmierć i stracony 29 maja 1946 r.
postwar_en: The main Dachau trial found him guilty of both charges and sentenced him to death on 13 December 1945. The review recommendation found no basis for clemency; the sentence was carried out on 29 May 1946.
limitations_en: The shots directed at the group of prisoners are documented, but the cited review does not establish whether anyone was hit; the profile does not add fatalities to that incident. No portrait with clearly documented publication rights was found.

name: Arnold Strippel
organization_en: SS; Buchenwald, Majdanek and Neuengamme concentration camps
organization_pl: SS; KL Buchenwald; KL Majdanek; KL Neuengamme
role_en: Rapportführer at Buchenwald, later a satellite-camp commander and regional camp-network chief
role_pl: Rapportführer KL Buchenwald, później komendant i kierownik sieci podobozów
role_de: Rapportführer in Buchenwald, später Außenlagerkommandant und Stützpunktleiter
role_ru: рапортфюрер в Бухенвальде, позднее комендант филиалов и руководитель региональной сети лагерей
role_fr: Rapportführer à Buchenwald, puis commandant de camps satellites et chef d’un réseau régional de camps
status_en: After a retrial, sentenced in 1970 to 6 years for aiding the collective murder of 21 prisoners; sentenced again in 1981 to 3 years and 6 months for aiding murder at Majdanek.
interpretation_en: The profile bases Strippel’s individual responsibility on final convictions for camp violence and for aiding murder at Buchenwald and Majdanek. It does not automatically attribute to him every crime committed by units under his authority.
crime_profile_pl: Jako Rapportführer w Buchenwaldzie osobiście stosował przemoc wobec więźniów i uczestniczył w akcji zakończonej rozstrzelaniem 21 żydowskich więźniów 9 listopada 1939 r. Pierwotne kary dożywocia zmieniono w 1970 r. na 6 lat za pomocnictwo w mordzie; w 1981 r. dostał także 3 lata i 6 miesięcy za pomocnictwo w mordzie w Majdanku, lecz tej kary nie odbył ze względów zdrowotnych.
postwar_en: In 1949 he received 21 life terms and an additional 10 years. On 22 November 1949, the appellate court overturned one grievous-bodily-harm conviction and the aggregate sentence; on 16 February 1950, the trial court reimposed the same result for that remanded part. In 1967 a retrial acquitted him on that count but sentenced him to 5 years for the remaining violence offences; he was released on 21 April 1969. In 1970 another retrial reclassified the killing of 21 prisoners as aiding murder and imposed 6 years, already served, after which he received compensation for excess imprisonment. In 1981 he received 3 years and 6 months in the Majdanek case but remained out of custody on health grounds (Haftverschonung). Bullenhuser Damm investigations were closed in 1967 and 1973; they reopened in 1979, a murder charge was filed in 1983, and the case ended in 1987 because he remained unfit to stand trial. The Vught investigation was closed in 1982.
limitations_en: The final 1970 judgment established aiding a collective murder involving 21 deaths, not that Strippel personally fired the shots. Former SS men implicated him in the Bullenhuser Damm case, but the proceedings from 1967 to 1987 ended without a verdict; the profile does not present that allegation as judicially proved. It sets no aggregate victim total. The Neuengamme Memorial material marks reproduction as prohibited and the photographer as unknown, so no portrait is used.

postwar_en: After the war he was tried in the fifth Ravensbrück staff trial and executed.
limitations_en: The profile is limited to conduct identified in the record of the fifth Ravensbrück trial. No individual victim total is assigned, and no additional order or act is attributed without an explicit source finding. No portrait with clearly documented publication rights was found.

role_fr: ministre-président de Brunswick

postwar_en: After his release he lived in Bad Harzburg; in 1970 he successfully sought a retroactive civil-service pension payment.
limitations_en: The 1950 judgment was quashed, so the profile also records the final 15-year term imposed after retrial. No individual victim total is assigned, and no additional order or act is attributed without an explicit source finding. No portrait with clearly documented publication rights was found.

postwar_en: After serving the sentence, he was released in 1952 and died on 23 April 1953.
limitations_en: His place of death remains undetermined; the profile does not expand the court findings with individual acts absent from the sources. Były to orzeczenia denazyfikacyjne, nie wyrok za zbrodnie wojenne: w 1950 r. berlińska izba uznała go za głównego winowajcę i wymierzyła 10 lat pozbawienia wolności; późniejsze postępowania nałożyły kary pieniężne.
postwar_en: After his release in 1958, d’Alquen worked in business and remained active in circles of former Waffen-SS members.
limitations_en: The profile records personal editorial decisions, co-authorship and command of a propaganda apparatus. It does not treat SS membership alone as proof of every crime and does not present denazification as a war-crimes trial. No individual victim total is assigned, and no additional order or act is attributed without an explicit source finding. No portrait with clearly documented publication rights was found.

It also preserves the distinction between the discontinued Marseille proceeding and the later Paris judgment. No individual victim total is assigned, and no additional order or act is attributed without an explicit source finding. No portrait with clearly documented publication rights was found.

Amerykański sąd wojskowy w głównym procesie Mauthausen uznał go za winnego i skazał na śmierć; rewizja zaleciła zatwierdzenie wyroku.
postwar_en: After trial, he remained in United States custody until the approved death sentence was carried out at Landsberg.
limitations_en: The profile records only the acts attributed to Spatzenegger in the individual section of the judgment review. It does not transfer to him every crime committed by the Mauthausen staff or assign him an individual victim total. No individual victim total is assigned, and no additional order or act is attributed without an explicit source finding. No portrait with clearly documented publication rights was found.

Amerykański sąd wojskowy uznał go za winnego i skazał na śmierć; organ rewizyjny uznał winę za udowodnioną, nie zalecił łaski, a Schmitza stracono 26 listopada 1948 r.

W procesie Pohla otrzymał 25 lat więzienia, po kontroli 20 lat, a następnie 15 lat; zwolniono go w marcu 1954 r. W 1963 r. sąd w Monachium wymierzył mu 3 lata więzienia za pomocnictwo w zabójstwie.

The separate 1934 act is described according to the conviction for aiding murder, without extending it to other conduct. No individual victim total is assigned, and no additional order or act is attributed without an explicit source finding. No portrait with clearly documented publication rights was found.

The tribunal found the evidence insufficient to impose criminal responsibility for the high-altitude, freezing or typhus experiments, so the profile does not attribute them to him. The birth date 18 July 1910 is taken from his sworn testimony, resolving conflicting secondary data. No individual victim total is assigned, and no additional order or act is attributed without an explicit source finding. No portrait with clearly documented publication rights was found.

postwar_en: He was interned from 1945 to 1948; in 1951 he was placed in denazification Group III. No final criminal judgment addressed his responsibility for Nazi crimes.
limitations_en: The absence of a criminal conviction does not mean an absence of historical responsibility. The profile separates Kaufmann’s documented decisions from the broader total of crimes committed by the apparatus he led. The photograph identified by Deutsche Biographie is marked InC and was therefore not used as a publication portrait.

limitations_en: The Soviet trial was closed and brief; the profile reports its result but does not present it as an independent standard for determining the whole of his historical responsibility. The scope of conduct rests on institutional research, not solely on the operative judgment. No portrait with a clearly open licence was found.

name: Martin Sommer
