crime_profile_pl: Jako nadzorca aresztu w KL Buchenwald torturował więźniów i zabijał ich zastrzykami. Landgericht Bayreuth uznał go za mordercę w 25 przypadkach i 3 lipca 1958 r. skazał na dożywocie; wyrok pozostał w mocy aż do jego śmierci.
postwar_en: In 1971 enforcement was interrupted for medical treatment, and in 1973 he was moved to a care home. Later parole requests were rejected; he died on 7 June 1988 while the sentence remained in force.
limitations_en: The judgment covered 25 murders and itself noted that this represented only part of the alleged crimes. The profile assigns no complete victim total and does not repeat unverified stories. No portrait with clearly documented publication rights was found.

name: Michael Seifert
tier_label_en: Designers of the machinery of destruction
organization_en: SS and the Bolzano transit camp
role_en: SS guard
role_pl: strażnik SS w obozie przejściowym w Bolzano
role_de: SS-Wachmann
role_ru: охранник СС
role_fr: garde SS
status_en: Sentenced to life imprisonment in 2000, extradited to Italy in 2008, and died in custody on 6 November 2010.
interpretation_en: The profile attributes to Seifert only the acts and service period established by the Italian military courts, together with the documented course of extradition and sentence enforcement.
crime_profile_pl: Trybunał Wojskowy w Weronie uznał Michaela Seiferta za winnego zabójstw jedenastu więźniów obozu przejściowego w Bolzano, popełnionych z premedytacją, okrucieństwem i torturami. W 2000 r. został skazany zaocznie na dożywocie, w 2008 r. wydany Włochom, a w 2010 r. zmarł podczas odbywania kary.
postwar_en: He was sentenced in absentia to life imprisonment in 2000. After the Canadian extradition proceedings, he was surrendered to Italy in 2008 and died in custody on 6 November 2010.
limitations_en: The account does not extend the judgment to charges on which Seifert was acquitted or to other crimes committed at the camp. The eleven victims are the scope of the final judicial finding, not a complete tally of violence at Bolzano. No portrait with clearly documented publication rights was found.

name: Oskar Schröder
organization_en: Luftwaffe Medical Service
role_en: Chief of the Luftwaffe Medical Service
role_pl: szef służby medycznej Luftwaffe
role_de: Chef des Sanitätswesens der Luftwaffe
role_ru: начальник медицинской службы Люфтваффе
role_fr: chef du service médical de la Luftwaffe
status_en: Sentenced to life imprisonment in 1947; the sentence was later reduced to 15 years; paroled on 1 April 1954.
interpretation_en: The profile grounds Schröder’s responsibility in the tribunal’s specific findings about his command function and the typhus, poison-gas and sea-water experiments, not merely in his place in the hierarchy.
crime_profile_pl: Oskar Schröder od stycznia 1944 r. kierował służbą medyczną Luftwaffe. Trybunał w procesie lekarzy uznał, że odpowiadał, pomagał i świadomie uczestniczył w eksperymentach na osobach niebędących obywatelami Niemiec i nieudzielających zgody. W 1947 r. skazano go na dożywocie; karę później zmniejszono do 15 lat.
postwar_en: In the Doctors’ Trial in 1947 he was convicted of war crimes and crimes against humanity and sentenced to life imprisonment. The sentence was later reduced to 15 years; he was paroled on 1 April 1954 under a 1-year ban on medical practice and a requirement to report monthly to German authorities. He died in 1959.
limitations_en: The tribunal assessed each experimental programme separately and did not establish Schroeder’s criminal connection to every charge; the profile does not extend responsibility to unproven allegations. Weindling documents the exact parole date and conditions. No portrait with clearly documented publication rights was found.

name: Otto Harder
tier_label_en: Designers of the machinery of destruction
organization_en: SS, Sachsenhausen concentration camp and Neuengamme concentration camp
organization_pl: SS, KL Sachsenhausen i KL Neuengamme
role_en: commandant of the Hannover-Ahlem satellite camp
role_pl: komendant podobozu Hannover-Ahlem KL Neuengamme
role_de: Kommandant des Außenlagers Hannover-Ahlem
role_ru: комендант филиала Ганновер-Алем
role_fr: commandant du camp annexe de Hannover-Ahlem
status_en: Convicted of war crimes in 1947 and sentenced to 15 years in prison; released early in 1951.
interpretation_en: The profile records Harder’s documented command role at the satellite camp and the outcome of the British trial, without attributing every act of subordinate personnel to him absent a separate finding.
crime_profile_pl: Otto Harder należał do SS i personelu obozów Sachsenhausen oraz Neuengamme, a w listopadzie 1944 r. został komendantem podobozu Hannover-Ahlem. Brytyjski sąd wojskowy skazał go w 1947 r. za zbrodnie wojenne na 15 lat więzienia; zwolniono go przedterminowo w 1951 r.
postwar_en: A British military court sentenced him to 15 years in prison for war crimes in 1947. He was released early in 1951.
limitations_en: The sources establish his command post and war-crimes conviction, but do not support attributing every death or act of violence at Hannover-Ahlem to Harder personally. No individual victim total is assigned. No portrait with clearly documented publication rights was found.

name: Robert Mulka
organization_en: SS and Auschwitz concentration camp
role_en: commandant’s adjutant and command-staff leader
role_pl: adiutant komendanta KL Auschwitz i kierownik sztabu komendantury
role_de: Adjutant des Kommandanten und Stabsführer der Kommandantur
role_ru: адъютант коменданта и начальник штаба комендатуры
role_fr: adjudant du commandant et chef de l’état-major du commandement du camp
status_en: Sentenced in 1965 to 14 years of penal servitude; released from custody on 20 February 1968.
interpretation_en: The profile follows the scope of responsibility established by the court: logistical and staff assistance in specific murder cases, without turning that finding into a claim that Mulka personally carried out every killing.
crime_profile_pl: Robert Mulka był adiutantem komendanta i kierownikiem sztabu KL Auschwitz. Sąd we Frankfurcie ustalił jego udział w uruchamianiu mechanizmu zagłady, w tym zapewnianiu ciężarówek i transportu Cyklonu B, i skazał go w 1965 r. za pomocnictwo w morderstwie w czterech przypadkach obejmujących po co najmniej 750 ofiar, na 14 lat ciężkiego więzienia.
postwar_en: In the first Frankfurt Auschwitz trial he was sentenced in 1965 to 14 years of penal servitude. After several periods in custody, he was released on 20 February 1968.
limitations_en: The minimum of at least 750 people in each of four cases reflects the court’s finding adopted in the defendant’s favour and is not a full victim total for Auschwitz. The profile attributes no conduct beyond the judgment. No portrait with clearly documented publication rights was found.

name: Siegfried Handloser
organization_en: Wehrmacht Medical Service and Armed Forces High Command
role_en: Chief of the Wehrmacht Medical Service
role_pl: szef służby medycznej Wehrmachtu
role_de: Chef des Wehrmachtssanitätswesens
role_ru: начальник медицинской службы вермахта
role_fr: chef du service médical de la Wehrmacht
status_en: Sentenced to life imprisonment in 1947; reduced to 20 years on 31 January 1951; imprisonment interrupted for medical reasons in 1954.
interpretation_en: The profile distinguishes Handloser’s hierarchical position from the responsibility found by the tribunal: knowledge that non-German nationals were used as experimental subjects and failure to exercise control within his sphere of competence.
crime_profile_pl: Siegfried Handloser był szefem służby medycznej Wehrmachtu. Trybunał w procesie lekarzy uznał, że wiedząc o wykorzystywaniu cudzoziemców w eksperymentach, nie sprawował wymaganej kontroli nad podległymi mu osobami. W 1947 r. skazano go na dożywocie; w 1951 r. karę zmniejszono do 20 lat, a w 1954 r. jej wykonywanie przerwano z powodu ciężkiej choroby.
postwar_en: In 1947 he was sentenced to life imprisonment for war crimes and crimes against humanity. On 31 January 1951 the sentence was reduced to 20 years, and in 1954 imprisonment was interrupted because of severe illness; he died on 3 July 1954.
limitations_en: The tribunal established Handloser’s connection to specified unlawful experiments but found insufficient evidence on some other allegations. The profile does not attribute every medical crime of the Wehrmacht or Waffen-SS to him. No portrait with clearly documented publication rights was found.

name: Simon Kiern
organization_en: SS and Dachau concentration camp
role_en: block leader and camp clerk
role_pl: Blockführer w KL Dachau
role_de: Blockführer und Lagerschreiber
role_ru: блокфюрер и лагерный делопроизводитель
role_fr: chef de bloc et employé administratif du camp
status_en: He was sentenced to death on 13 December 1945; the sentence was carried out on 28 May 1946.
interpretation_en: The profile distinguishes the individual findings described in the review record from the broader common-design doctrine applied to the camp staff.
crime_profile_pl: SS-Hauptscharführer i Blockführer KL Dachau. Akta przeglądu procesu wiążą go z maltretowaniem więźniów, zabiciem jednego więźnia oraz udziałem w egzekucjach; sąd skazał go na śmierć, a wyrok wykonano 28 maja 1946 r.
postwar_en: A United States military court sentenced him to death on 13 December 1945; he was executed on 28 May 1946.
limitations_en: No individual victim total is assigned and no conduct beyond the judicial record is attributed. No portrait with clearly documented publication rights was found.

name: Walter Buch
organization_en: Nazi Party and Supreme Party Court
role_en: supreme party judge and Reichsleiter
role_pl: najwyższy sędzia partyjny NSDAP
role_de: Oberster Parteirichter und Reichsleiter
role_ru: высший партийный судья и рейхсляйтер
role_fr: juge suprême du parti et Reichsleiter
status_en: In July 1949 he was classified as a main offender; the five-year labour-camp term was reduced to three and a half years and deemed served.
interpretation_en: The documented responsibility concerns his leadership of the party judiciary and his forwarding of a report that shielded perpetrators of anti-Jewish violence; the cited sources do not show that Buch ordered the pogrom.
crime_profile_pl: Najwyższy sędzia partyjny NSDAP i Reichsleiter. W lutym 1939 r. przekazał Göringowi raport sądu partyjnego o przemocy z 9–10 listopada 1938 r.; dokumentował on łagodne sankcje partyjne i wnioski o umorzenie postępowań karnych, ale nie dowodzi, że Buch wydał rozkaz pogromu.
postwar_en: In July 1949 the labour-camp term was reduced to three and a half years and deemed served; he died by suicide on 12 September 1949.
limitations_en: The profile does not attribute an order to launch the pogrom or individual killings to Buch without a source finding. The photograph in the detention report dated 22 June 1945 is marked on Wikimedia Commons as public domain, as a work of the U.S. Government.

name: Walter Kuntze
tier_label_fr: Rouages de la guerre et de l’occupation
organization_en: Wehrmacht and 12th Army
role_en: deputy Wehrmacht commander in the Southeast
role_pl: zastępca dowódcy Wehrmachtu na Południowym Wschodzie
role_de: stellvertretender Wehrmachtbefehlshaber Südost
role_ru: заместитель командующего вермахта на Юго-Востоке
role_fr: commandant adjoint de la Wehrmacht dans le Sud-Est
status_en: On 19 February 1948 he was convicted on Counts I, III and IV and sentenced to life imprisonment; he was medically released in February 1953 without the conviction being set aside.
interpretation_en: Kuntze’s responsibility is principally command responsibility, arising from a signed order, reports reaching his headquarters and his failure to prevent unlawful practices by subordinate units.
crime_profile_pl: Generał Wehrmachtu i zastępca dowódcy na Południowym Wschodzie. Trybunał w procesie zakładników uznał jego odpowiedzialność dowódczą za zbrodnie odwetowe i za zaniechanie reakcji na meldowane prześladowania Żydów i Romów; wyraźnie nie ustalił, że wydał rozkaz ich rozstrzelania lub przewiezienia do obozu zbiorczego.
postwar_en: He was sentenced to life imprisonment on 19 February 1948, medically released in February 1953 without the conviction being set aside, and died in Detmold on 1 April 1960.
limitations_en: The judgment expressly stated that the record did not show Kuntze ordered the shooting of Jews and Roma or their transfer to a camp. The profile does not extend responsibility beyond the court’s findings. The 1948 portrait by the U.S. Army Signal Corps, held by the National Archives and Records Administration, is marked as public domain on Wikimedia Commons.

name: Wilhelm Henkel
organization_en: Waffen-SS and Mauthausen concentration camp
role_en: chief camp dental officer
role_pl: główny dentysta Waffen-SS w KL Mauthausen
role_de: leitender Lagerzahnarzt
role_ru: главный лагерный стоматолог
role_fr: dentiste en chef du camp
status_en: On 13 May 1946 he was sentenced to death in the parent Mauthausen case; the sentence was carried out on 28 May 1947.
interpretation_en: The judgment establishes Henkel’s participation in the camp system as chief dental officer. The profile does not turn the collective charge into a claim that he personally carried out every act listed in it.
crime_profile_pl: Główny dentysta Waffen-SS w KL Mauthausen w latach 1941–1943. Amerykański sąd wojskowy skazał go w głównym procesie Mauthausen na podstawie zarzutu wspólnego planu dotyczącego systemu przemocy obozowej; nie przypisujemy mu bez źródła każdego czynu wymienionego w zarzucie zbiorowym.
postwar_en: In the parent Mauthausen case he was sentenced to death on 13 May 1946 and executed on 28 May 1947.
limitations_en: The available sources establish his role and conviction under the common-design charge but do not justify attributing every act in that collective charge to him personally or assigning an individual victim total. No portrait with clearly documented publication rights was found.

name: Willi Tessmann
organization_en: Hamburg Gestapo and Fuhlsbüttel police prison
role_en: commandant of the police prison
role_pl: komendant więzienia policyjnego Fuhlsbüttel
role_de: Kommandant des Polizeigefängnisses
role_ru: комендант полицейской тюрьмы
role_fr: commandant de la prison de police
status_en: A British military court sentenced him to death in September 1947; he was executed at Hamelin on 29 January 1948.
interpretation_en: The profile combines the responsibility of the commandant with specifically documented personal conduct and does not attribute acts of other guards to Tessmann without an individual finding.
crime_profile_pl: Ostatni komendant więzienia policyjnego Fuhlsbüttel. Źródła instytucjonalne dokumentują jego udział w przesłuchaniach Gestapo, umieszczaniu agentów w celach więźniów i wspieraniu maltretowania, a także doprowadzenie pięciu rosyjskich robotnic przymusowych na egzekucję w 1943 r.; brytyjski sąd wojskowy skazał go na śmierć.
postwar_en: In the second Fuhlsbüttel case he was sentenced to death in September 1947 and executed at Hamelin on 29 January 1948.
limitations_en: Institutional panels give different days in September for the judgment, so the profile records only the month and year. It does not attribute acts of other defendants without an individual finding. A known photograph has unclear reuse status, so no portrait is published without a clear legal basis.

name: Albert Schwartz
organization_en: SS · Buchenwald concentration camp · Mittelbau concentration camp
role_en: labour-deployment officer who organized prisoner forced labour at Buchenwald and Mittelbau
role_pl: Arbeitseinsatzführer w KL Buchenwald i KL Mittelbau
role_de: Arbeitseinsatzführer, der die Häftlingszwangsarbeit in Buchenwald und Mittelbau organisierte
role_ru: руководитель использования труда заключённых, организовывавший принудительный труд в Бухенвальде и Миттельбау
role_fr: responsable de l’affectation au travail ayant organisé le travail forcé des détenus à Buchenwald et Mittelbau
status_en: sentenced to death in 1947; commuted to life imprisonment in 1948; released in 1954
interpretation_en: Schwartz’s documented responsibility rests on his direction of prisoner labour deployment in the main camp and its subcamps and on the American tribunal’s adjudication, not on an attribution of a particular personal killing.
postwar_en: On 14 August 1947 Schwartz was sentenced to death in the Buchenwald trial; on 8 June 1948 the sentence was commuted to life imprisonment, and on 14 May 1954 the remaining term was cancelled. He died on 5 July 1984.
limitations_en: The sources establish his office, organization of forced labour and adjudication, but do not prove that Schwartz personally committed a specified killing. Wikimedia Commons classifies the portrait as a public-domain official work of the U.S. Army Signal Corps; the Commons file is used with archive provenance. The variant ‘Albert Fredrich’ is confined to the archive photograph caption.

name: Heinrich August Bender
organization_en: SS · Buchenwald concentration camp
organization_pl: SS · KL Buchenwald · 3. Dywizja Pancerna SS Totenkopf
role_en: second camp physician involved in prisoner selections at Buchenwald
role_pl: drugi lekarz obozowy KL Buchenwald
role_de: zweiter Lagerarzt und Beteiligter an Häftlingsselektionen in Buchenwald
role_ru: второй лагерный врач, участвовавший в селекциях заключённых в Бухенвальде
role_fr: second médecin du camp impliqué dans les sélections de détenus à Buchenwald
status_en: sentenced to 10 years in 1947; reduced to 3 years and released in 1948
interpretation_en: Bender’s responsibility rests on his medical office within the camp apparatus, his documented participation in selections determining forced labour and the deportation of sick and weak prisoners, and the tribunal’s conviction.
postwar_en: On 14 August 1947 Bender was sentenced to 10 years in prison; on 8 June 1948 the term was reduced to 3 years, and on 21 June 1948 he was released. A later investigation ended without a new indictment.
limitations_en: The institutional sources document selections and the subsequent conviction, but this profile does not attribute a specified killing personally to Bender without individualized evidence. Wikimedia Commons classifies the portrait as a public-domain official work of the U.S. Army Signal Corps; the Commons file is used with archive provenance.

name: August Richard Ruhnke
organization_en: SS · Dachau concentration camp · Riederloh subcamp
role_en: deputy camp leader of the Dachau subcamp at Riederloh
role_pl: zastępca kierownika podobozu KL Dachau w Riederloh
role_de: stellvertretender Lagerführer des Dachauer Außenlagers Riederloh
role_ru: заместитель начальника подлагеря Дахау в Ридерло
role_fr: chef adjoint du kommando extérieur de Dachau à Riederloh
status_en: sentenced to death on 18 April 1947 for the murder of at least 19 prisoners; executed on 14 November 1947
interpretation_en: Ruhnke’s responsibility encompasses his leadership role in the subcamp and the individual killings and violence established in the military proceedings. The figure of at least 19 is the minimum covered by the judgment, not a complete toll for the subcamp.
postwar_en: On 18 April 1947 a U.S. military court sentenced Ruhnke to death for the proven murder of at least 19 Jewish prisoners. He was hanged at Landsberg on 14 November 1947.
limitations_en: The case index gives a précis, while the municipal volume synthesizes the judgment and testimony. Without a complete personnel card, no detailed SS rank is assigned. The archival photograph mentioned in a note has neither a public URL nor a verified reuse licence, so no portrait is used.

name: Emil Euler
organization_en: Waffen-SS · Mauthausen concentration camp · Ebensee
role_en: commander of guard companies in the Mauthausen camp complex
role_pl: dowódca kompanii wartowniczych w kompleksie KL Mauthausen
role_de: Kommandeur von Wachkompanien im Lagerkomplex Mauthausen
role_ru: командир охранных рот в комплексе Маутхаузен
role_fr: commandant de compagnies de garde dans le complexe de Mauthausen
status_en: sentenced to 10 years in 1947; extradited to Poland, convicted again and executed on 13 September 1950
interpretation_en: Euler’s documented responsibility encompasses command over guard personnel and specific witness evidence of beatings, use of a dog against prisoners and shootings. The individual acts of violence are explicitly presented as testimony evaluated in the proceedings.
postwar_en: In 1947 a U.S. court found Euler guilty and sentenced him to 10 years in prison. He was then extradited to Poland, convicted again and executed on 13 September 1950.
limitations_en: The cited NARA passages do not give a birthplace or the precise city of the Polish execution. The Arolsen file confirms a further body of testimony, but without identified folios it is not used here to add dates. No portrait with verified reuse rights was located.
